title: Supervisor – Community Employment (CE)
description: The CE Sponsoring Organisation (Ringsend & District Response to Drugs) is responsible for the terms and conditions of employment of Supervisors as outlined in the CE Procedures Manual. These guidelines are included in the job specification for the CE Supervisor.  Job Title: Supervisor - Community Employment  Reporting to: Project Manager and Chairperson - RDRD Project Management Committee Function: To ensure the effective and efficient management and co-ordination of the human, financial and material resources of the CE Scheme and report to the Project Management Committee on its implementation. A core aspect of the role is to support and coach CE participants towards gaining the skills and competencies in preparation for employment.  Key Result Areas  Administration  • Ensure the provision of an efficient financial and accounting system in line with CE corporate governance requirements as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Ensure that financial returns i.e. wages claims, materials claims, and participant development grant claims meet the standard as laid down by Department of Employment Affairs and Social Protection (DEASP).  • Ensure implementation of systems controlling the operation of all finances e.g. cheque payments book, petty cash system, debtors, creditors and participant’s payroll, bank account and PRSI returns as directed by the Project Management Committee.   • Ensure prompt and accurate payment of participant allowances. Ensure the security of cash/equipment on scheme as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Install and manage effective time keeping record system for participants on scheme.  • Liaise with the local DEASP Office as required.  Training & Development Provision  • Carry out an identification of learner needs with each participant on the scheme as part of the Individual Learner Plan process.  • Identify needs and source and co-ordinate cost effective training/development opportunities in line with DEASP procurement guidelines.  • Prepare an Individual Learning Plan for each Participant for submission to DEASP in accordance with CE procedures.  • Ensure access to recognised qualifications for participants, with a focus on the achievement of relevant qualifications including Major Awards on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) or industry related equivalent. Plan and procure relevant training opportunities which have been approved by DEASP. Maintain and update training records for each participant on the project as part of their Individual Learner Plans. Monitor and review training inputs with the participants. Plan and organise work placements — internal and external as required.  • Report on ILP developments to the Project Management Committee.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie Human Resources  • Co-ordinate the recruitment of CE applicants per the CE Recruitment and Referral Process issued by DEASP.  • Plan and co-ordinate the approved work schedules and ensure contracts of employment are in place for all participants.  • Communicate effectively with all participants on the scheme using team meetings and individual formal and informal 'one-to-one' meetings.  • Develop a mutual understanding with participants in relation to their needs for re-entry to work where the participant had been long-term unemployed and needs to develop a clear progression path. •  Implement job search activities with participants.  • Deal with all disciplinary matters in relation to participants in accordance with DEASP CE procedures. •  Liaise with employers to promote progression to work and work with other support organisations as needed.  • Develop an exit plan with each participant.  • Follow-up and report on participants for up to 4 months on exit from CE.  • Engage in training and development as detailed in Procedures Manual.  • Report to the Project Management Committee as required.  Scheme Management  • Provide a safe and healthy environment for participants - both in terms of facilities and work practices. • Ensure work experience placements on scheme are in line with CE application. Supervise, schedule and manage participants.  • Fully participate in training and development opportunities provided by the Sponsor and by DEASP as required for the post.  • Carry out any other function relevant to the position of Supervisor (Community Employment) as indicated by the Project Management Committee.  Financial Monitoring and Programme and Training Monitoring  • Ensure the CE scheme is compliant with financial, programme and training monitoring requirements as detailed in the CE Operating Procedures.  Progression of CE Participants  • Exit Planning  • Intensive Job Search activities as part of exit planning  • Engagement with Local Employer • Database of Employers  PERSONAL SPECIFICATION  Essential  • Knowledge of post Have a solid understanding of the role of the Community Employment Supervisor as it pertains to project management and programme delivery to long-term unemployed and vulnerable adults. Display responsibility, commitment and motivation to implement the objectives of the Community Employment Programme.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie • Work Experience  Previous supervisory and people management experience relevant to post (3 years minimum). - Previous experience in Administration, Project Management and/or Training or other relevant positions.  • Interpersonal Skills  Effective communication skills. Competent report writing skills. Experience of working with vulnerable individuals and jobseekers. - Capable of directing, motivating, coaching and mentoring jobseekers. Ability to work under the direction of the Sponsoring Organisation for the effective implementation of the CE Programme in line with the CE Operational Procedures.  • Qualifications  Major Award at 3rd Level (NFQ Level 6 or higher) in Business/Financial Administration, Training, Human Resources, Project Management or related disciplines. ICT skills essential (e.g. MS Office) and certification in Addiction Studies ideal. Salary & Benefits • Salary: Aligned with DSP CE Supervisor Scale, commencing at Point 1. Although in the case of a person already employed as a CE supervisor being the successful candidate, they would receive their current rate of pay. • 39 hours per week standard full-time role. • Access to staff support, CISM (Critical Incident Stress Management), and Employee Assistance services. Apply by sending CV to the manager at catherine.meleady@rdrd.ie or by post to the Manager, 17 Irishtown Road, Dublin D04PW10.  Closing date for applications is 5pm on Tuesday 17th of November.

title: Supervisor – Community Employment (CE)
description: The CE Sponsoring Organisation (Ringsend & District Response to Drugs) is responsible for the terms and conditions of employment of Supervisors as outlined in the CE Procedures Manual. These guidelines are included in the job specification for the CE Supervisor.  Job Title: Supervisor - Community Employment  Reporting to: Project Manager and Chairperson - RDRD Project Management Committee Function: To ensure the effective and efficient management and co-ordination of the human, financial and material resources of the CE Scheme and report to the Project Management Committee on its implementation. A core aspect of the role is to support and coach CE participants towards gaining the skills and competencies in preparation for employment.  Key Result Areas  Administration  • Ensure the provision of an efficient financial and accounting system in line with CE corporate governance requirements as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Ensure that financial returns i.e. wages claims, materials claims, and participant development grant claims meet the standard as laid down by Department of Employment Affairs and Social Protection (DEASP).  • Ensure implementation of systems controlling the operation of all finances e.g. cheque payments book, petty cash system, debtors, creditors and participant’s payroll, bank account and PRSI returns as directed by the Project Management Committee.   • Ensure prompt and accurate payment of participant allowances. Ensure the security of cash/equipment on scheme as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Install and manage effective time keeping record system for participants on scheme.  • Liaise with the local DEASP Office as required.  Training & Development Provision  • Carry out an identification of learner needs with each participant on the scheme as part of the Individual Learner Plan process.  • Identify needs and source and co-ordinate cost effective training/development opportunities in line with DEASP procurement guidelines.  • Prepare an Individual Learning Plan for each Participant for submission to DEASP in accordance with CE procedures.  • Ensure access to recognised qualifications for participants, with a focus on the achievement of relevant qualifications including Major Awards on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) or industry related equivalent. Plan and procure relevant training opportunities which have been approved by DEASP. Maintain and update training records for each participant on the project as part of their Individual Learner Plans. Monitor and review training inputs with the participants. Plan and organise work placements — internal and external as required.  • Report on ILP developments to the Project Management Committee.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie Human Resources  • Co-ordinate the recruitment of CE applicants per the CE Recruitment and Referral Process issued by DEASP.  • Plan and co-ordinate the approved work schedules and ensure contracts of employment are in place for all participants.  • Communicate effectively with all participants on the scheme using team meetings and individual formal and informal 'one-to-one' meetings.  • Develop a mutual understanding with participants in relation to their needs for re-entry to work where the participant had been long-term unemployed and needs to develop a clear progression path. •  Implement job search activities with participants.  • Deal with all disciplinary matters in relation to participants in accordance with DEASP CE procedures. •  Liaise with employers to promote progression to work and work with other support organisations as needed.  • Develop an exit plan with each participant.  • Follow-up and report on participants for up to 4 months on exit from CE.  • Engage in training and development as detailed in Procedures Manual.  • Report to the Project Management Committee as required.  Scheme Management  • Provide a safe and healthy environment for participants - both in terms of facilities and work practices. • Ensure work experience placements on scheme are in line with CE application. Supervise, schedule and manage participants.  • Fully participate in training and development opportunities provided by the Sponsor and by DEASP as required for the post.  • Carry out any other function relevant to the position of Supervisor (Community Employment) as indicated by the Project Management Committee.  Financial Monitoring and Programme and Training Monitoring  • Ensure the CE scheme is compliant with financial, programme and training monitoring requirements as detailed in the CE Operating Procedures.  Progression of CE Participants  • Exit Planning  • Intensive Job Search activities as part of exit planning  • Engagement with Local Employer • Database of Employers  PERSONAL SPECIFICATION  Essential  • Knowledge of post Have a solid understanding of the role of the Community Employment Supervisor as it pertains to project management and programme delivery to long-term unemployed and vulnerable adults. Display responsibility, commitment and motivation to implement the objectives of the Community Employment Programme.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie • Work Experience  Previous supervisory and people management experience relevant to post (3 years minimum). - Previous experience in Administration, Project Management and/or Training or other relevant positions.  • Interpersonal Skills  Effective communication skills. Competent report writing skills. Experience of working with vulnerable individuals and jobseekers. - Capable of directing, motivating, coaching and mentoring jobseekers. Ability to work under the direction of the Sponsoring Organisation for the effective implementation of the CE Programme in line with the CE Operational Procedures.  • Qualifications  Major Award at 3rd Level (NFQ Level 6 or higher) in Business/Financial Administration, Training, Human Resources, Project Management or related disciplines. ICT skills essential (e.g. MS Office) and certification in Addiction Studies ideal. Salary & Benefits • Salary: Aligned with DSP CE Supervisor Scale, commencing at Point 1. Although in the case of a person already employed as a CE supervisor being the successful candidate, they would receive their current rate of pay. • 39 hours per week standard full-time role. • Access to staff support, CISM (Critical Incident Stress Management), and Employee Assistance services. Apply by sending CV to the manager at catherine.meleady@rdrd.ie or by post to the Manager, 17 Irishtown Road, Dublin D04PW10.  Closing date for applications is 5pm on Tuesday 17th of November.

description: Role Overview:We are seeking a highly organised and proactive Production and Materials Planner to join our operations team in a dynamic dry mortar manufacturing environment. title: Supervisor – Community Employment (CE)
description: The CE Sponsoring Organisation (Ringsend & District Response to Drugs) is responsible for the terms and conditions of employment of Supervisors as outlined in the CE Procedures Manual. These guidelines are included in the job specification for the CE Supervisor.  Job Title: Supervisor - Community Employment  Reporting to: Project Manager and Chairperson - RDRD Project Management Committee Function: To ensure the effective and efficient management and co-ordination of the human, financial and material resources of the CE Scheme and report to the Project Management Committee on its implementation. A core aspect of the role is to support and coach CE participants towards gaining the skills and competencies in preparation for employment.  Key Result Areas  Administration  • Ensure the provision of an efficient financial and accounting system in line with CE corporate governance requirements as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Ensure that financial returns i.e. wages claims, materials claims, and participant development grant claims meet the standard as laid down by Department of Employment Affairs and Social Protection (DEASP).  • Ensure implementation of systems controlling the operation of all finances e.g. cheque payments book, petty cash system, debtors, creditors and participant’s payroll, bank account and PRSI returns as directed by the Project Management Committee.   • Ensure prompt and accurate payment of participant allowances. Ensure the security of cash/equipment on scheme as directed by the Project Management Committee.  • Install and manage effective time keeping record system for participants on scheme.  • Liaise with the local DEASP Office as required.  Training & Development Provision  • Carry out an identification of learner needs with each participant on the scheme as part of the Individual Learner Plan process.  • Identify needs and source and co-ordinate cost effective training/development opportunities in line with DEASP procurement guidelines.  • Prepare an Individual Learning Plan for each Participant for submission to DEASP in accordance with CE procedures.  • Ensure access to recognised qualifications for participants, with a focus on the achievement of relevant qualifications including Major Awards on the National Framework of Qualifications (NFQ) or industry related equivalent. Plan and procure relevant training opportunities which have been approved by DEASP. Maintain and update training records for each participant on the project as part of their Individual Learner Plans. Monitor and review training inputs with the participants. Plan and organise work placements — internal and external as required.  • Report on ILP developments to the Project Management Committee.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie Human Resources  • Co-ordinate the recruitment of CE applicants per the CE Recruitment and Referral Process issued by DEASP.  • Plan and co-ordinate the approved work schedules and ensure contracts of employment are in place for all participants.  • Communicate effectively with all participants on the scheme using team meetings and individual formal and informal 'one-to-one' meetings.  • Develop a mutual understanding with participants in relation to their needs for re-entry to work where the participant had been long-term unemployed and needs to develop a clear progression path. •  Implement job search activities with participants.  • Deal with all disciplinary matters in relation to participants in accordance with DEASP CE procedures. •  Liaise with employers to promote progression to work and work with other support organisations as needed.  • Develop an exit plan with each participant.  • Follow-up and report on participants for up to 4 months on exit from CE.  • Engage in training and development as detailed in Procedures Manual.  • Report to the Project Management Committee as required.  Scheme Management  • Provide a safe and healthy environment for participants - both in terms of facilities and work practices. • Ensure work experience placements on scheme are in line with CE application. Supervise, schedule and manage participants.  • Fully participate in training and development opportunities provided by the Sponsor and by DEASP as required for the post.  • Carry out any other function relevant to the position of Supervisor (Community Employment) as indicated by the Project Management Committee.  Financial Monitoring and Programme and Training Monitoring  • Ensure the CE scheme is compliant with financial, programme and training monitoring requirements as detailed in the CE Operating Procedures.  Progression of CE Participants  • Exit Planning  • Intensive Job Search activities as part of exit planning  • Engagement with Local Employer • Database of Employers  PERSONAL SPECIFICATION  Essential  • Knowledge of post Have a solid understanding of the role of the Community Employment Supervisor as it pertains to project management and programme delivery to long-term unemployed and vulnerable adults. Display responsibility, commitment and motivation to implement the objectives of the Community Employment Programme.  www.rdrdthespellmancentre.ie • Work Experience  Previous supervisory and people management experience relevant to post (3 years minimum). - Previous experience in Administration, Project Management and/or Training or other relevant positions.  • Interpersonal Skills  Effective communication skills. Competent report writing skills. Experience of working with vulnerable individuals and jobseekers. - Capable of directing, motivating, coaching and mentoring jobseekers. Ability to work under the direction of the Sponsoring Organisation for the effective implementation of the CE Programme in line with the CE Operational Procedures.  • Qualifications  Major Award at 3rd Level (NFQ Level 6 or higher) in Business/Financial Administration, Training, Human Resources, Project Management or related disciplines. ICT skills essential (e.g. MS Office) and certification in Addiction Studies ideal. Salary & Benefits • Salary: Aligned with DSP CE Supervisor Scale, commencing at Point 1. Although in the case of a person already employed as a CE supervisor being the successful candidate, they would receive their current rate of pay. • 39 hours per week standard full-time role. • Access to staff support, CISM (Critical Incident Stress Management), and Employee Assistance services. Apply by sending CV to the manager at catherine.meleady@rdrd.ie or by post to the Manager, 17 Irishtown Road, Dublin D04PW10.  Closing date for applications is 5pm on Tuesday 17th of November.

title: Team Leader
description: Estimated start date: 02/01/2027Minimum rate for this position is €38,691 per annum.Job Location: Sanas Community Services Limited, Hibernia House, Jamestown Road, Finglas Co. Dublin, D11PX08Company description:Sánas provides an alternative respite service for children and young adults. Through our centres we provide a range of relaxing and engaging activities, as well as supporting engagement in local amenities. We are welcoming applications for our centre in Finglas, Co.Dublin.Team Lead – Job description:Sánas provides alternative respite support for children and young adults with intellectual disabilities and/or autism.We are looking for a motivated candidate who believes in developing people’s strengths. As the leader of a team of Direct Support Workers, you will provide your team with guidance and support, and ensure that they deliver on our promise of a strengths-based approach with our service users. Your day-to-day focus will be:- Coordinating and managing the daily operations of support services, including the provision of formal supervision and management of a team of Direct Support Workers- To liaise with the service user's family and relevant members of multi-disciplinary teams, community groups and voluntary bodies with the aim of furthering Service User needs- Encouraging a supportive and collaborative culture among your team- Ensuring the ongoing focus on service’ users strengths and uncovering new ways of developing these- Understanding and delivering on Sánas’ core Vision, Mission and Values- Assuming management responsibilities in the absence of the Assistant Service Manager/Service Manager.- Fostering the development of team members to become the next Sánas Team Leaders while we support you on your professional journeyRequirements:-Third level Qualification in Health Care, Social Care, or Teaching.- Experience of management and supervising both individuals and teams- At least 1 year paid or voluntary experience supporting children or young people with additional needs in a care, respite, education or community setting.- Experience providing personal care, including feeding, toileting, hygiene and mobility support- Fluent written and spoken spoken English, to complete daily records and care documentation accurately.- Right to work in Ireland, or eligibility for an employment permit, and willingness to complete Garda vetting before starting.- Ability to work a 40-hour week, including rota-based or flexible hoursDesirable:- Training in positive behavior support (PBS) or de-escalation techniques- Experience using visual supports or other communication supports with children who have communication needs.Benefits:- The successful applicant will be offered an attractive remuneration and benefits package.Informal enquiries to Fia@sanasireland.ie

title: Localization QA Engineer with Norwegian
description: OverviewGlobeTech is a global provider of software localisation, translation, quality assurance (QA) and data analysis services to the multinational IT sector. We provide market-leading solutions to our clients, with the core objective of helping them expand and grow their businesses in an increasingly personalised and data-driven world.Established in 1997 by two expert engineers, our bespoke services have enabled us to expand globally and become a trusted partner to our clients. Why? Because we work with excellent people!Are you ready to start a new career opportunity and relocate to Cork, Ireland? We are looking for talented individuals to join our growing team within the consumer electronics sector.In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with some of the world's most innovative software products, in a dynamic company culture and alongside cutting-edge technologies.You and your team will be responsible for ensuring the quality of a wide variety of software products in your native language. You will also have the opportunity to share your ideas and contribute in a collaborative working environment.Responsibilities* Perform localisation testing on software, printed documents, help content and hardware products. * Report issues identified using internal tools, providing relevant information and suggestions, and following the resolution process through to completion. * Analyse international functionality issues. * Work cross-functionally with international software QA centres, engineering teams, translators and project managers to ensure the delivery of world-class products to international markets. * Design, implement and organise manual test plans. * Create, maintain and execute automated test procedures. * Develop software test automation scripts using technologies such as Swift, Objective-C, Python and Ruby, or other programming languages as required. * Carry out technical software reviews to identify opportunities for test automation. Qualifications* Native-level proficiency in the required language, with a strong understanding of linguistic principles. * Experience in software localisation and/or internationalisation. * An analytical mindset and an interest in identifying software defects and improving product quality. * Strong programming and technical skills. Offer* Working Hours: 10am–6pm, Monday to Friday (39 hours per week). * Salary: €42,000 per annum. * Location: Hollyhill, Cork. * Eircode: T23 YK84* Employer: GlobeTech. * Contract: 6-month contract, with the possibility of extension.

You will make sure all of the client's needs are met in a completely individual way, and as an ambassador of Resilience's values, you will representBest Quality - providing best-in-class care always.Individuality - applying a person-centered approach to meet each individual's abilities, needs and challengesEmpowerment - helping all our service-users live their very best life and achieve their optimal potential.What Will Your Responsibilities Be?The delivery of client care needs and the development, implementation and evaluation of Support Plans;Ensure that practices within the service comply with Resilience's policies and procedures, to maintain the highest standards;Liaise with Multi-Disciplinary Teams ('MDTs') when required;Provide support to colleagues within the team setting;Act as a mentor for new staff and foster a positive learning environment;Participate in the development and review of risk assessments and report concerns.What is Required?            You will have:FETAC/QQI level 5/Social Care/healthcare assistant qualification or equivalent;Completed or be willing to complete a Patient Manual Handling course;Eligibility to work in Ireland;A strong sense of empathy, flexibility and a team-oriented work ethic.Previous experience working with adults/children with physical, sensory and intellectual disabilities would be an advantageA Full Drivers Licence is desirable.How Will You Benefit?This is your opportunity to:Develop and progress your career through full induction, training and ongoing development.Enjoy excellent rates of pay Resilience Rewards employee discounts e.g discounted health insuranceMake your mark as part of a service that is changing the future of care in Ireland.Employee Assistance Programme 24/7Resilience4Me Health and Well-being ForumEnjoy a personal, one-to-one approach to social care support work.Benefit from the full support of management.Earn from our paid Refer-a-Friend scheme

title: Welders
description: Our client, Padraig Thornton Waste Disposal Limited t/a Thorntons Recycling, based in Dublin 12, is currently seeking Welders for immediate start at their facility in Dublin 12.Qualifications:1-3 years’ of previous welding experience required. Welding Certification preferred but not essential. There are no minimum academic requirements. Further training will be provided on-the-job as required. Candidates must be able to mig weld, perform fillet welds and read drawingsGeneral Duties / Responsibilities / Experience:-    To operate welding equipment in order to join metalwork pieces together-    To use fusion welding processes based on various techniques and materials-    To perform simple visual inspection of welds-    To perform fillet welds, mig welding and to read drawings-    To wear appropriate protective gear and adhere to safety standards-    To smooth burred surfaces and recognise metal imperfections-    This role requires knowledge of welding techniques, torch temperature for metal processes, metal thermal conductivity and fuel gas-    Essential knowledge includes welding from drawings (2D and 3D), mig welding and fillet welds-    Essential skills include aligning components, joining metals and operating welding equipment, including oxy-fuel torch-    Candidates must be competent to apply arc welding techniques and precision metalworking techniques-    Candidates must be competent to ensure correct metal temperature and handle fuels-    Candidates must have experience in recognising signs of corrosion and removing inadequate workpieces-    Candidates must have experience in performing metal active gas welding and inert gas welding-    Candidates must have 1-3 years’ of relevant experience as a Welder-    Experience as a Welder in the waste/recycling industry is a plusAnnual Remuneration: €36,605.00; Pay Rate €18.05 per hourWork Location: Padraig Thornton Waste Disposal Limited t/a Thorntons Recycling, Unit S3B Henry Road, Parkwest Business Park, Dublin, D12 AC2X.Number of hours work each week: 39If you're interested in this role, please apply with an up-to-date CV to info@crewitresourcing.com or call 019020688 to enquire for more details.

title: Localisation QA Engineer with Hebrew
description: OverviewGlobeTech is a global provider of software localisation, translation, quality assurance (QA) and data analysis services to the multinational IT sector. We provide market-leading solutions to our clients, with the core objective of helping them expand and grow their businesses in an increasingly personalised and data-driven world.Established in 1997 by two expert engineers, our bespoke services have enabled us to expand globally and become a trusted partner to our clients. Why? Because we work with excellent people!Are you ready to start a new career opportunity and relocate to Cork, Ireland? We are looking for talented individuals to join our growing team as a Localisation QA Engineer within the consumer electronics sector.In this role, you will have the opportunity to work with some of the world's most innovative software products, in a dynamic company culture and alongside cutting-edge technologies.As a Localisation QA Engineer, you and your team will be responsible for ensuring the quality of a wide variety of software products in your native language. You will also have the opportunity to share your ideas and contribute in a collaborative working environment.ResponsibilitiesPerform localisation testing on software, printed documents, help content and hardware products.Report issues identified using internal tools, providing relevant information and suggestions, and following the resolution process through to completion.Analyse international functionality issues.Work cross-functionally with international software QA centres, engineering teams, translators and project managers to ensure the delivery of world-class products to international markets.Design, implement and organise manual test plans.Create, maintain and execute automated test procedures.Develop software test automation scripts using technologies such as Swift, Objective-C, Python and Ruby, or other programming languages as required.Carry out technical software reviews to identify opportunities for test automation.QualificationsNative-level proficiency in the required language, with a strong understanding of linguistic principles.Experience in software localisation and/or internationalisation.An analytical mindset and an interest in identifying software defects and improving product quality.Strong programming and technical skills.OfferWorking Hours: 10am–6pm, Monday to Friday (39 hours per week).Salary: €42,000 per annum.Location: Hollyhill, Cork.Eircode: T23 YK84Employer: GlobeTech.Contract: 6-month contract, with the possibility of extension.

title: Data Analytics Executive
description: Job Overview The Data Analytics Executive plays a key operational role in ensuring our field teams and commercial teams have access to accurate data, reliable systems, and clear reporting that supports consistent execution across all channels.This role is ideal for someone highly organised, confident with Excel, and eager to rapidly build capability in Power BI and data systems. It requires a proactive self‑starter who enjoys problem‑solving, improving processes, and supporting others.  Key Responsibilities Act as the central day‑to‑day contact for field and commercial teams on system and data queries.Manage the daily operation of field systems and tools (e.g., REX, XTEL), ensuring accuracy and reliability.Apply validation checks to identify and resolve data quality issues early.Maintain and update customer, outlet and product master data in line with agreed standards.Produce and maintain operational reports and dashboards using Excel and Power BI.Provide clear, action‑focused reporting to support field execution and commercial decision‑making.Provide Level 1 incident support, logging and triaging issues with IT and resolver teams as needed.Produce and maintain operational reports and dashboards using Excel and Power BI.Provide clear, action‑focused Data reports to support field execution and commercial decision‑making.Build and optimize data pipelines and integrations (SAP, REX, XTEL) to ensure timely, reliable insightsManage data quality and governance across CRM, order, and customer systems; maintain accurate master dataIdentify recurring issues and support simplification, standardisation and automation of processes using data analytics.Provide analytics and system support; troubleshoot issues and collaborate with IT teamsAct as the central day‑to‑day contact for field and commercial teams on system and data queries.Monitor adoption and effectiveness of reporting tools and field systemsRequirements Strong Excel skills (Pivot Tables, Power Query).Knowledge and experience with BI.Experience with CRM or field system

title: tecnico chimico
description: GI GROUP SPA, prima multinazionale italiana del lavoro, per un'importante realtà industriale internazionale operante nel settore della produzione di apparecchiature ad alta tecnologia, ricerca un: Analista Chimico Responsabilità: Sviluppo metodi e validazione: sviluppare procedure analitiche per metalli (composizione bulk e tracce) con OES/XRF, combustione ed estrazione a caldo; e per metalli in soluzione dopo digestione con ICP-OES/ICP-MS. Pianificare ed eseguire validazione/verifica (accuratezza, ripetibilità/riproducibilità, linearità, range, selettività, robustezza, carryover, LOD/LOQ) e confermare la tracciabilità metrologica tramite CRM. Definire e mantenere i budget di incertezza di misura (preparazione campione, calibrazione, performance strumentale) in linea con applicazione e decision rule. Redigere e mantenere piani/report di validazione e documenti controllati (SOP/WI) con gestione revisioni e valutazione impatti delle modifiche; Data integrity e gestione dati: garantire acquisizione, elaborazione e reporting secondo procedure controllate (configurazione strumenti, audit trail, versioning, calcoli tracciabili). Eseguire review tecnica e validazione risultati (stato calibrazioni, conformità QC, integrità campioni, controlli di plausibilità). Gestire archiviazione sicura e recupero dei dati grezzi/record con leggibilità nel lungo periodo e accessi controllati. Gestire i dati in modo strutturato con LIMS e fogli validati applicando principi ALCOA++. Condurre indagini e azioni correttive per non conformità, eventi di data integrity o QC fuori specifica; implementare CAPA e verificarne l'efficacia; Esecuzione analisi chimiche avanzate: svolgere analisi con metodi validati, inclusa preparazione campioni (pesata, digestione, diluizione), calibrazione e verifiche QC. Preparare reagenti e standard con tracciabilità documentata; gestire CRM e soluzioni di riferimento (stoccaggio, etichettatura, scadenze). Eseguire controlli di routine e verifiche prestazionali; coordinare manutenzione e troubleshooting con fornitori. Assicurare gestione sicura di chimici e rifiuti (risk assessment, DPI, compliance ambientale e regole di sito); Reportistica e interpretazione risultati: preparare report di prova conformi (identificazione metodo, tracciabilità, stato QC, incertezza quando applicabile). Interpretare risultati per caratterizzazione materiali, monitoraggio corrosione, failure analysis e supporto al processo; comunicare conclusioni agli stakeholder. Supportare definizione di decision rules e dichiarazioni di conformità coerenti con requisiti cliente/norme; Gestione subfornitori e audit: valutare tecnicamente report di laboratori esterni (equivalenza metodo, incertezza, evidenze di tracciabilità, adeguatezza QC). Supportare qualifica e follow-up fornitori come esperto di analisi chimiche; contribuire a preparazione ed esecuzione audit. Supportare audit interni/esterni (enti di accreditamento, clienti) fornendo evidenze oggettive su validazione, incertezza, competenza e data management; Requisiti: Laurea in Chimica, Chimica Analitica, Ingegneria Chimica o diploma 5 anni indirizzo chimico; Minimo 5 anni di esperienza nel ruolo all'interno di laboratori industriali accreditati ISO/IEC 17025; Esperienza diretta in attività di analisi composizione metallica e analisi metalli in matrice acquosa ICP-OES/ICP-MS; Conoscenza livello B2/C1 lingua inglese; Cosa offriamo: Inserimento diretto in azienda; CCNL Metalmeccanico Industria; Retribuzione prevista compresa tra €37.000,00 to €48.500,00 lordi annui, definita in base all'inquadramento contrattuale, alla mansioni previste e alle caratteristiche della posizione. description: Per conto di una realtà strutturata operante nel settore chimico-farmaceutico, inserita in una fase di trasformazione digitale e di rafforzamento dei presidi di governance, sicurezza e standardizzazione a livello di Gruppo, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Chief Technology Officer La posizione si colloca a diretto riporto del CIO e rappresenta un ruolo 'ponte' tra l'operatività quotidiana e la definizione/adozione di policy, processi e controlli, con focus particolare sulla gestione delle sussidiarie estere e sul governo dei fornitori. Responsabilità principali Governare infrastrutture e servizi IT (on-prem / cloud / ambienti ibridi), garantendo continuità operativa e adeguati livelli di resilienza sui diversi siti del Gruppo (Italia ed estero). Rafforzare cybersecurity e compliance, con un approccio proattivo: definizione e implementazione di policy, controlli, monitoraggio e iniziative di remediation (es. percorso NIS2, GDPR e requisiti tipici di contesti regolamentati chimico-pharma). Gestire networking & security a livello corporate: architetture di rete, segmentazione, protezione perimetrale, gestione del rischio e riduzione dell'esposizione (anche a seguito di incidenti e hardening dei sistemi di produzione). Presidiare la relazione con le sussidiarie: standard IT di Gruppo, allineamento operativo, coordinamento rollout, gestione priorità/escalation e comunicazione strutturata verso gli stakeholder locali. Governare fornitori e contratti: selezione/valutazione partner, gestione SLA e performance, controllo costi, razionalizzazione contratti e asset (device, servizi, licenze), challenge costruttivo dei provider. Coordinare l'IT Service Management e l'evoluzione dei processi (in un contesto dove il ticketing di 1° livello è esternalizzato): chiarire ruoli/responsabilità, migliorare qualità del servizio, tracciabilità e reporting. Contribuire alla roadmap tecnologica insieme al CIO: priorità di investimento, architetture target, standard, piani di miglioramento e misurazione dell'avanzamento. Requisiti Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Infrastructure / IT Operations / IT Service Management / Cyber Security Governance in aziende strutturate, preferibilmente in contesti industriali e/o regolamentati (chimico/pharma è un plus rilevante). Solida capacità di gestione multi-sito e internazionale e di coordinamento 'a distanza' con sussidiarie/plant. Esperienza concreta nel governo dei fornitori (contratti, SLA, costi, qualità del servizio, delivery). Approccio orientato a processi, policy e controllo del rischio, con capacità di passare da modello reattivo a modello proattivo. Buone capacità comunicative e di stakeholder management (corporate, plant, funzioni centrali). Inglese fluente (mandatorio). Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede di lavoro: Milano Nord. Con una rete capillare di oltre 1.000 stazioni di servizio (di cui circa 300 di proprietà) sul territorio nazionale e importanti partnership commerciali, l'azienda è licenziatario esclusivo in Italia di un prestigioso brand petrolifero globale. In forte crescita e orientata al futuro, sta trasformando la rete in hub multiservizio, integrando alla proposta tradizionale soluzioni per la transizione ecologica (ricarica elettrica rapida, biocarburanti HVO) e servizi retail/ristorazione. Sales Territory Manager - TOSCANA SUD (Grosseto) Il ruolo La risorsa, riportando all'Area Manager, gestirà e svilupperà la rete nell'area assegnata in Toscana Sud, con presidio costante del territorio (circa 80% della settimana). Responsabilità principali Definire e implementare il piano commerciale dell'area e raggiungere gli obiettivi di vendita e redditività. Gestire la relazione con gestori/presidianti e stakeholder della rete. Sviluppare e fidelizzare il portafoglio clienti, gestendo trattative, condizioni commerciali, campagne promo e scontistiche. Monitorare il mercato e individuare nuove opportunità (stazioni strategiche/partner). Gestire aspetti amministrativi e documentali dei punti vendita assegnati e supportare budget e forecast. Gestire segnalazioni/reclami garantendo la qualità del servizio e la soddisfazione cliente. Requisiti Laurea (o titolo equivalente) in ambito economico/giuridico/ingegneristico. Forte attitudine commerciale e negoziale, capacità analitiche e organizzative. Buona conoscenza MS Office e strumenti digitali Esperienza nel ruolo, preferibilmente in contesti strutturati. La provenienza dal settore Oil (downstream) può essere considerata titolo preferenziale. Verranno valutate con interesse anche candidature provenienti da settori Retail NON-OIL (energia, utilities, logistica, FMCG). Conoscenze amministrative/tecnico-manutentive/gestionali. Inglese B1-B2. Dimestichezza negli spostamenti sul territorio. Si offre: Inserimento con contratto a tempo indeterminato. Di cosa ti occuperai? Supportare la preparazione e il consolidamento di budget annuale, forecast periodici e piani finanziari a lungo termine. Monitorare spese operative (OPEX) e costi aziendali, garantendo l'allineamento con budget e obiettivi. Effettuare analisi mensili degli scostamenti vs budget/forecast/anno precedente, identificando driver e azioni correttive. Predisporre report periodici, dashboard e presentazioni per management locale e stakeholder. Analizzare redditività, efficienza dei costi e performance operative, formulando raccomandazioni concrete. Collaborare con responsabili di dipartimento e leader funzionali per comprendere i driver di costo e supportare il processo decisionale. Supportare la chiusura mensile, validando i dati e assicurando coerenza tra actual e assunzioni di forecast. Sviluppare e mantenere modelli finanziari per pianificazione e business case (ROI, sensitivity, scenari). Condurre analisi ad hoc su rischi/opportunità, investimenti e iniziative di cost saving. Garantire accuratezza e integrità dei dati nei sistemi di reporting e pianificazione. Contribuire al miglioramento continuo di processi FP&A, automazione del reporting e metodologie di pianificazione. Lavorare in modo cross-funzionale con Accounting, Operations, HR, Fleet, Procurement e altre funzioni per una vista completa della performance. Requisiti Laurea in Economia, Finanza, Accounting o affini. Esperienza di 3-5+ anni in FP&A/Controllo di Gestione/Finance Business Partnering (preferibile in contesti strutturati o società di consulenza). Solida conoscenza di: budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, reporting gestionale, closing support. Forte capacità analitica e attitudine a trasformare i dati in insight e azioni. Ottima padronanza del pacchetto Office (Excel), e familiarità con ERP aziendali (es. SAP). Conoscenza fluente della lingua italiana e buona della lingua inglese (livello B2). Ottime capacità comunicative e relazionali, approccio proattivo, autonomia, attenzione al dettaglio e orientamento ai risultati completano il profilo. Orario di lavoro: full time lun - ven. Possibilità di lavoro da remoto 2 giorni a settimana. Sede: San Donato Milanese - zona non raggiungibile con i mezzi pubblici. Cosa offriamo? Contratto a tempo indeterminato diretto con l'azienda. title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Grafton Office* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Accounting, Sales, Marketing, HR, Legal, Purchasing and Office Management. Siamo un team di professionisti appassionati, lavoriamo per accompagnare i nostri candidati verso le mansioni ed i contesti aziendali più coerenti con le loro competenze e le loro aspettative. Per importante azienda cliente ricerchiamo: Buying Planner La risorsa, inserita all'interno dell'Ufficio Buying e in collaborazione con i Buyer e la Direzione Commerciale, supporterà le attività di pianificazione, monitoraggio e gestione operativa degli ordini, contribuendo all'ottimizzazione della disponibilità del prodotto, della rotazione delle scorte e della marginalità. Nello specifico, la figura inserita si occuperà di: Monitorare le performance di vendita dei prodotti, analizzando sell-in, sell-out, stock, rotazioni, stock coverage e marginalità per categoria, brand, linea e punto vendita, individuando trend, criticità e opportunità commerciali; Supportare la pianificazione degli assortimenti e dei fabbisogni di prodotto per insegna, categoria, stagione e canale distributivo, sulla base dei dati storici, previsionali e degli obiettivi commerciali; Supportare il team Buying nella definizione dei quantitativi di acquisto e nella costruzione dell'assortimento; Monitorare il ciclo di vita del prodotto, dall'ingresso in assortimento fino alla fase di fine stagione, individuando eventuali criticità e opportunità di intervento; Analizzare le giacenze e individuare tempestivamente situazioni di overstock, understock e slow moving, supportando la definizione delle relative azioni correttive; Supportare il team Buying, in collaborazione con Planning & Allocation, nell'individuazione delle esigenze di riassortimento e redistribuzione del prodotto; Monitorare l'andamento dei budget di acquisto e degli obiettivi economici assegnati alle diverse categorie merceologiche, segnalando eventuali scostamenti; Gestire operativamente l'inserimento, l'emissione e l'aggiornamento degli ordini di acquisto a sistema, assicurando la correttezza delle informazioni relative a prodotti, quantità, prezzi e condizioni concordate; Monitorare l'avanzamento degli ordini, verificando conferme d'ordine, variazioni, cancellazioni ed eventuali anomalie e interfacciandosi con i fornitori per gli aspetti operativi; Presidiare il follow-up delle consegne e il rispetto delle tempistiche previste, segnalando tempestivamente eventuali ritardi o scostamenti rispetto alla pianificazione e garantendo l'allineamento tra piano di acquisto, ordini emessi e merce in consegna; Predisporre e mantenere aggiornata la reportistica relativa a ordini, budget impegnato, consegne, stock e performance di prodotto, fornendo analisi a supporto dell'Ufficio Buying e della Direzione Commerciale. Requisiti richiesti: Laurea in discipline economiche, statistiche, gestionali, moda o affini. Esperienza pregressa di almeno 2-3 anni in ruoli di Buying Planning, Merchandise Planning, Buying, Merchandising o Product Management, preferibilmente nel settore fashion retail. Conoscenza delle logiche di assortimento, pianificazione e gestione dello stock nel settore retail. Spiccata capacità di analisi e interpretazione dei dati. Utilizzo avanzato di Excel; gradita la conoscenza di strumenti di Business Intelligence. Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. Completano il profilo: approccio analitico e commerciale, capacità di lettura delle performance di prodotto, ottime capacità organizzative e di pianificazione, precisione, problem solving, Sede di lavoro: Palermo, Orari: Lun-Ven 8:30 - 13:00 / 14:30 - 18:00 CCNL Commercio Range Retributivo previsto: € 23.300 - € 27.000. title: commerciante all’ingrosso
description: Il nostro cliente è una realtà italiana solida e strutturata attiva nelle grandi opere/infrastrutture, con forte presidio su cantieri, impianti e mezzi , che ci ha incaricato di ricercare per la sede di Sondrio un/una SENIOR BUYER - Lavori/Servizi/Forniture | Grandi Opere/Infrastrutture (Sondrio) La risorsa riporterà al Responsabile Ufficio Acquisti e avrà il compito di assicurare l'attività di approvvigionamento di lavori, servizi e forniture in ambito grandi opere e infrastrutture pubbliche, in funzione delle esigenze produttive dei cantieri per la parte plant & equipment. Nello specifico, la risorsa: Gestisce l'albo fornitori: selezione, aggiornamento e proposta di approvazione in linea con procedure interne. Prepara e invia le richieste di offerta, raccoglie le proposte e coordina le verifiche tecniche con le funzioni richiedenti. segue la negoziazione economica e contrattuale (tempi, condizioni, SLA), con attenzione a qualità, lead time e ottimizzazione costi. Desideriamo entrare in contatto con Senior Buyers in possesso di laurea in Ingegneria (Civile, Gestionale, Edile, Meccanica, dei Processi) oppure Diploma di Geometra con esperienza negli acquisti legati ai cantieri, in particolare su impianti e macchinari, materiali, ricambi e servizi (es. manutenzioni) e provenienza da contesti strutturati (ad es società di infrastrutture/costruzioni, EPC contractors, Oil & Gas, aziende produttrici di mezzi di movimentazione/sollevamento). È richiesta la conoscenza della normativa sugli Appalti Pubblici, una buona padronanza del pacchetto Office (soprattutto Excel) e, preferibilmente, familiarità con sistemi ERP (SAP). Completano il profilo autonomia operativa, capacità di lavorare in team e orientamento al risultato. Sede di lavoro: Sondrio con smart working 8 gg/mese. È richiesta motivazione al trasferimento; è previsto un pacchetto di relocation (inclusa foresteria, contributo spese viaggio) Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. L'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati e candidate, nel rispetto del D.Lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei Decreti Legislativi n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento. Invitiamo chi si candida a leggere l'informativa privacy ai sensi degli artt. 13 e 14 del Reg. EU 679/2016 al seguente indirizzo https://it.wyser-search.com/privacy-policy/. #LI-AM

title: geologo/geologa
description: Grafton Engineering* è un team dedicato a valorizzare le esperienze, le competenze e il potenziale dei candidati in ambito Progettazione, Logistica e Supply Chain, Production&Maintenance, Qualità - Sicurezza e Ambiente, Process & Project Management. Per Azienda internazionale, leader nella progettazione e costruzione di macchinari per la produzione industriale, Automazione, Robotica e Converting, selezioniamo: SOFTWARE ENGINEER - Automation & Robotics Di cosa ti occuperai? Inserito/a nel reparto Engineering, contribuirai allo sviluppo di soluzioni software avanzate per macchine e impianti automatici, integrando automazione, robotica e visione artificiale, con focus su performance, affidabilità e sicurezza. In particolare ti occuperai di: Analisi di richieste tecniche post-vendita (upgrade, miglioramenti, bug fixing) e supporto alla definizione della soluzione (fattibilità e impatti). Sviluppo & commissioning automazione: PLC, Motion, HMI/SCADA (Siemens/Rockwell/Beckhoff/Codesys). Test/validazione/ottimizzazione in collaborazione con i referenti tecnici di plant. Troubleshooting e analisi di anomalie con approccio strutturato (raccolta evidenze, riproducibilità, proposta di fix). Produzione/aggiornamento della documentazione tecnica (specifiche di base, note di rilascio, report test). Collaborazione con team cross-funzionali (meccanica, elettrica, automazione) per integrazione e miglioramento continuo Hai queste competenze e caratteristiche? Laurea in Ingegneria (Automazione/Robotica/Informatica/Meccatronica/Elettrica-Elettronica o affini); gradita magistrale/specializzazione AI-Vision. 2-5 anni di esperienza in sviluppo software per automazione industriale, macchine/impianti, o sistemi complessi in contesti industriali. Programmazione: C++ e/o C# e/o Python; graditi OOP, UML, Design Patterns, DBMS. Familiarità con contesti di automazione industriale e integrazione software-hardware; gradita conoscenza di protocolli/fieldbus e ambienti Linux. Soft skills: analisi, problem solving, teamwork, collaborazione cross-funzionale. Inglese buono/fluente. Orario di lavoro: Full time 40 ore settimanali, dal lunedì al venerdì. Richiesta presenza in plant, con con possibilità di smart working fino a 8 giorni al mese. Offerta Contrattuale: Inserimento con contratto a tempo indeterminato; CCNL applicato: Metalmeccanico; Livello di inquadramento: B2. La retribuzione prevista è compresa tra € 35.000 e € 45.000 lordi annui (RAL), definita in base all'inquadramento, alle mansioni e alle caratteristiche del profilo. Sono inoltre previsti mensa aziendale, piano welfare, pacchetto benefit dedicato alla cura della persona e formazione tecnica continua sulle tecnologie avanzate utilizzate all'interno del reparto Engineering. Sede di lavoro: San Giovanni Teatino (CH), con contributo mensile alla relocation per candidati/e provenienti da fuori regione. Se pensi di avere le competenze e l'attitudine per questo ruolo, inviaci la tua candidatura! L'offerta si intende rivolta a candidati e candidate nel rispetto del D.lgs. n. 198/2006 e ss.mm.ii. e dei Decreti Legislativi n. 215 e n. 216 del 2003 sulle parità di trattamento. Invitiamo chi si candida a leggere l'informativa privacy ai sensi degli artt. 13 e 14 del Reg. EU 679/2016 al seguente indirizzo www.gigroup.it/privacy-candidati

Attraverso questo percorso, acquisirai le competenze per la realizzazione delle calzature di lusso, come: - Analisi delle componenti costruttive del modello di calzatura - Realizzazione del prototipo di tomaia e fodera - Tecniche di produzione: realizzazione dei processi costruttivi relativi al montaggio e finissaggio di varie tipologie di calzature - Controllo qualitativo del prodotto finito Al termine dell'intero percorso, previo esame finale, verrà rilasciato un Certificato di Specializzazione tecnica superiore (IV livello EQF) subito spendibile nel mercato del lavoro italiano. Il percorso inizierà a fine Novembre 2026 e prevederà una formazione di 800 ore (di cui il 50% presso il Politecnico Calzaturiero e il 50% svolte presso aziende calzaturiere del lusso, tramite tirocinio curricolare). Quali sono i vantaggi di questo percorso? - Formazione teorica e pratica fornita da maestri esperti del settore che condivideranno la loro esperienza e il loro know how; - opportunità di apprendere e lavorare in un ambiente stimolante e innovativo, direttamente presso prestigiose firme del lusso; - possibilità di assunzione stabile presso l'azienda in somministrazione con Gi Group a conclusione del percorso di formazione. L'offerta è rivolta a candidate/i, anche senza esperienza pregressa nel settore, in possesso di uno dei seguenti requisiti: - Diploma di Istruzione Secondaria Superiore, o titolo superiore diploma professionale conseguito in seguito ai percorsi quadriennali di IeFP; - Persone NON in possesso di diploma, ma con pregresse esperienze lavorative in lavori manuali, e previa verifica delle competenze acquisite in precedenti percorsi di istruzione, formazione e lavoro. Tempi e luoghi: - Sede della formazione interna: Politecnico Calzaturiero, Via Venezia n. 62 - Capriccio di Vigonza (PD) - Sede della formazione esterna/tirocinio: c/o aziende calzaturiere del Settore Lusso, in Riviera del Brenta. Inizio percorso da fine novembre 2026, è richiesta disponibilità full time da lunedì a venerdì. title: direttore dei sistemi informatici/direttrice dei sistemi informatici
description: Per conto di una realtà strutturata operante nel settore chimico-farmaceutico, inserita in una fase di trasformazione digitale e di rafforzamento dei presidi di governance, sicurezza e standardizzazione a livello di Gruppo, siamo alla ricerca di una figura di Chief Technology Officer La posizione si colloca a diretto riporto del CIO e rappresenta un ruolo 'ponte' tra l'operatività quotidiana e la definizione/adozione di policy, processi e controlli, con focus particolare sulla gestione delle sussidiarie estere e sul governo dei fornitori. Responsabilità principali Governare infrastrutture e servizi IT (on-prem / cloud / ambienti ibridi), garantendo continuità operativa e adeguati livelli di resilienza sui diversi siti del Gruppo (Italia ed estero). Rafforzare cybersecurity e compliance, con un approccio proattivo: definizione e implementazione di policy, controlli, monitoraggio e iniziative di remediation (es. percorso NIS2, GDPR e requisiti tipici di contesti regolamentati chimico-pharma). Gestire networking & security a livello corporate: architetture di rete, segmentazione, protezione perimetrale, gestione del rischio e riduzione dell'esposizione (anche a seguito di incidenti e hardening dei sistemi di produzione). Presidiare la relazione con le sussidiarie: standard IT di Gruppo, allineamento operativo, coordinamento rollout, gestione priorità/escalation e comunicazione strutturata verso gli stakeholder locali. Governare fornitori e contratti: selezione/valutazione partner, gestione SLA e performance, controllo costi, razionalizzazione contratti e asset (device, servizi, licenze), challenge costruttivo dei provider. Coordinare l'IT Service Management e l'evoluzione dei processi (in un contesto dove il ticketing di 1° livello è esternalizzato): chiarire ruoli/responsabilità, migliorare qualità del servizio, tracciabilità e reporting. Contribuire alla roadmap tecnologica insieme al CIO: priorità di investimento, architetture target, standard, piani di miglioramento e misurazione dell'avanzamento. Requisiti Esperienza consolidata in ruoli di IT Infrastructure / IT Operations / IT Service Management / Cyber Security Governance in aziende strutturate, preferibilmente in contesti industriali e/o regolamentati (chimico/pharma è un plus rilevante). Solida capacità di gestione multi-sito e internazionale e di coordinamento 'a distanza' con sussidiarie/plant. Esperienza concreta nel governo dei fornitori (contratti, SLA, costi, qualità del servizio, delivery). Approccio orientato a processi, policy e controllo del rischio, con capacità di passare da modello reattivo a modello proattivo. Buone capacità comunicative e di stakeholder management (corporate, plant, funzioni centrali). Inglese fluente (mandatorio). Sede e modalità di lavoro Sede di lavoro: Milano Nord. Possibili trasferte presso sedi del Gruppo in Italia e all'estero in funzione dei progetti. Inquadramento Contratto a tempo indeterminato, livello Quadro. RAL indicativa 70-80k + bonus variabile 10% Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. Min. del 15/04/2014 Prot. N: 39/4903) e si occupa di ricerca e selezione di profili manageriali ed executive. title: Database and network professionals
description: Il nostro cliente è uno dei principali System Integrator italiani specializzati in Networking, Data Center, Security e soluzioni Cloud, con una forte componente di progettazione infrastrutturale e una lunga storia nel mondo delle telecomunicazioni. Ci ha incaricati di ricercare un/a Senior Pre Sales Engineer - Networking che verrà inserito/a all'interno della Technology Unit NDCS della Business Unit PPS (Public & Private Sector) e opererà nell'area di Prevendita, contribuendo alla definizione di soluzioni innovative in ambito Networking, Data Center, Security e Cloud per clienti Enterprise e Pubblica Amministrazione. L'obiettivo del ruolo è supportare le strutture commerciali nella qualificazione delle opportunità, nella progettazione delle soluzioni e nella predisposizione delle offerte tecnico-economiche, collaborando con vendor, partner e team di delivery. Principali responsabilità - Supportare le attività di prevendita tecnica nell'ambito di gare, offerte e opportunità - commerciali in tecnologia multivendor. - Analizzare i requisiti tecnici e di business dei clienti. - Definire architetture e soluzioni infrastrutturali in ambito Networking e Data Center. - Predisporre documentazione tecnica, High Level Design, allegati di gara e documenti di - offerta. - Collaborare alla definizione della soluzione economica e alla stima degli effort progettuali. - Interfacciarsi con vendor e distributori. - Supportare PoC, workshop, demo e presentazioni tecniche. - Collaborare con Delivery e Operation. - Contribuire all'evoluzione dell'offerta aziendale. - Supportare il coordinamento tecnico di offerte complesse. Competenze tecniche richieste - Architetture IP Enterprise e Service Provider. - Routing e switching (OSPF, IS-IS, BGP, MPLS, Segment Routing). - Tecnologie LAN, WAN e Data Center. - Esperienza su soluzioni Cisco, HPE ed altri vendor. - SD-WAN e SDN. - Wireless Enterprise. - Cloud e Network Security. - Processi ITIL e Service Management. Requisiti - Esperienza di almeno 8-10 anni in attività specifiche nel ruolo di cui al profilo richiesto - Esperienza nella definizione di soluzioni complesse. - Buona conoscenza della lingua inglese. - Disponibilità a trasferte. Sede di Lavoro: Milano CCNL Metalmeccanico, Livello B3 O Quadro A1 RALT (fisso + variabile): 70.000€ SW fino al 50%, Ticket da 9 euro. Possibilità di auto aziendale ad uso promiscuo La nostra organizzazione opera nel rispetto della parità di genere e con l'impegno di sostenere l'inclusività e la diversity. Invitiamo a sottoporre le candidature evitando di fornire informazioni relative a matrimonio, gravidanza, responsabilità familiari, stato di famiglia. #LI-AM2 Wyser S.r.l. è autorizzata ad operare dal Ministero del Lavoro e delle Politiche Sociali (Aut. title: Mining, manufacturing and construction supervisors
description: Grafton LifeScience* is a dedicated team focused on enhancing the experiences, skills, and potential of candidates in Sales & Marketing, Clinical Research, Regulatory, and Operations within the Pharmaceutical and Medical sectors. We also specialize in roles related to customer support in the health-impacting distribution field (Pharmacies and Parapharmacies).We are a team of passionate professionals working to guide our candidates towards roles and corporate environments that best match their skills and expectations. In partnership with an integrated CDMO with around 60 locations worldwide, specializing in integrated sterile liquid and lyophilized product development and commercial manufacturing, we offer an opportunity for QC PDS Quality Operations Analyst Summary: As a QC PDS Quality Operations Analyst, you will join our collaborative PDS team, working cross-functionally in a GMP/GLP-regulated environment and contributing to the development and delivery of advanced products and technologies that help address global challenges in healthcare and environmental protection. Job Responsibilities: - The primary focus of this role will be the review and verification of analytical activities and documentation generated by the QC PDS laboratory, ensuring accuracy, completeness, data integrity, and compliance with applicable procedures and GMP/GLP requirements. - Review of analytical testing and documentation related to product release, stability studies, analytical method validation and transfer activities, and Active Pharmaceutical Ingredients (APIs), using standard analytical techniques and instrumentation such as HPLC, UV-Vis, FT-IR, and Pharmacopoeial methods. - You will also receive appropriate laboratory training to maintain the capability to operate as a QC PDS Laboratory Analyst. - When required, you may provide hands-on support to routine laboratory activities and analytical testing. We offer an environment that values performance, quality, and innovation, providing the resources and opportunities to develop your expertise and grow your career while contributing to our mission of enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. Skills: - Experience in a GMP Quality Control lab. - Familiarity with techniques including HPLC, UV-Vis, FT-IR, and compendial tests (pH, osmolality, container content, appearance). - Ability to work to critical timelines. - Effective interpersonal skills and attention to detail. - Strong documentation and analytical review capabilities. Education/Experience: - Degree in Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Chemistry (CTF) or a related scientific field preferred. - Experience in reviewing QC data and documentation in a GMP-regulated environment. Contract Offer: 12 months Fixed-term agency contract. CCNL Chimico-Farmaceutico, livello D1. Working time weekly: Monday to Friday Place of work: Monza Grafton LifeScience is a specialization of Gi Group Spa authorized to operate by the Ministry of Labor and Social Policies (Authorization No. 26/11/2004 PROT. 1101 - SG). Il ruolo è pensato per una figura con forte attitudine imprenditoriale, credibilità industriale e capacità di esecuzione in una fase iniziale di impresa. Familiarità con modelli GEO/MEO/LEO, servizi MSS, satellite IoT, NTN, VSAT o connettività in aree remote. title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.

Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt. Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

description: **Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntija: vie yrityksen rahoitushanke itse alusta loppuun****Jokainen yritys ansaitsee rahoituksen, joka on rakennettu sen omaan tilanteeseen ja hankkeeseen.** Siihen tarvitaan ihminen, joka ymmärtää yrityksen tilanteen, ja työkalu, joka tekee valmistelusta nopeaa ja perusteltua.FSG Financial Services Group hakee **itsenäisiä yrittäjiä Trusty Finance -rahoitusasiantuntijoiksi**. Olemme rakentaneet uuden palvelumallin ja työkalun, jonka avulla et vain ohjaa asiakasta eteenpäin. **Viet rahoitushankkeen itse ensimmäisestä keskustelusta loppuun saakka.****Trusty Finance Broker** tuo asiakastyön, rahoitusanalyysin ja rahoittajille valmisteltavan aineiston samaan työympäristöön. Sinulle se tarkoittaa **vähemmän rutiinia ja enemmän aikaa asiakkaalle**. Voit hoitaa useampia rahoitushankkeita laadusta tinkimättä.**Trusty Finance Broker muuttaa rahoitusasiantuntijan arjen**Hyvä asiakaskeskustelu on vasta alku. Sen jälkeen yrityksen tilanne pitää jäsentää, rahoituksen perusteet arvioida ja aineisto valmistella. Trusty Finance Broker vie tämän työn kanssasi järjestelmällisesti maaliin.- **Asiakastyötila pitää kokonaisuuden käsissäsi.** Asiakkaat, rahoitushankkeet, sovitut asiat ja seuraavat askeleet ovat yhdessä näkymässä. Näet heti, missä kukin hanke on ja mitä tänään kannattaa tehdä. - **Trusty AI-Engine laskee, sinä tarkistat.** Se yhdistää sääntöpohjaisen laskennan ja tekoälyn. Se laskee tilinpäätöksistä ja tapaamistiedoista, millainen rahoitus hankkeelle sopii ja mihin takaisinmaksu perustuu. - **Asiakasraportti tekee tuloksista ymmärrettäviä.** Asiakas saa raportin päätöksenteon tueksi, ja sinä saat pohjan keskustelulle rahoituksen vaihtoehdoista. - **Rahoittajapaketti kokoaa valmistellun aineiston.** Siitä näkyy, mitä yritys aikoo toteuttaa ja miksi rahoitus kannattaa. Trusty Finance toimittaa sen niille rahoittajille, joille hanke sopii. - **Apua saat suoraan työympäristöstä.** Vaativassa tilanteessa pyydät FSG Financial Services Groupin tukea Ilmoita FSG:lle -toiminnolla. **Sinä tunnet asiakkaan, ja työkalu hoitaa laskennan, dokumentoinnin ja aineiston kokoamisen.** Yritys valitsee saamistaan rahoitustarjouksista itselleen parhaan.**FSG Trusty Finance Akatemia auttaa sinut alkuun ja pidemmälle****Rahoitusalan taustaa ei tarvita aloittamiseen.** Trusty Finance Brokeriin on rakennettu koulutusympäristö, FSG Trusty Finance Akatemia. Kokemus yrittäjien kanssa toimimisesta antaa hyvän pohjan, mutta **tärkeintä on oikea ote**: kuuntelet asiakasta, haluat oppia ja viet sovitut asiat loppuun.Tehtävä sopii sinulle, jos tartut oma-aloitteisesti uusiin asiakaskeskusteluihin, työskentelet huolellisesti ja haluat rakentaa omaa liiketoimintaasi pitkäjänteisesti.**Yhteistyömalli: toimit itsenäisenä yrittäjänä**Kyseessä on **yrittäjämalli, ei työsuhde**. title: Service Engineer
description:
Voor een internationale speler binnen de chemische industrie zoeken we een Technical Service Engineer voor de Belgische markt. Het betreft een vaste functie bij onze opdrachtgever. Je werkt volledig remote en rapporteert aan het team in Nederland. Eén keer per maand ben je aanwezig op het Nederlandse kantoor voor teamoverleg.

Je maakt deel uit van een klein team van drie collega’s in België. Daarbij werk je nauw samen met een ervaren Account Manager die als mentor zal optreden. Daarnaast stem je regelmatig af met technische experten en het laboratoriumteam in Nederland, wat grotendeels vanop afstand gebeurt. Als Technical Service Engineer ben je de technische partner voor klanten in België. Je ondersteunt hen bij het optimaliseren van processen, adviseert over technische oplossingen en bouwt duurzame relaties uit. Op termijn krijg je de mogelijkheid om door te groeien naar een rol als Account Manager.

Function

  • Bezoeken van klanten en ondersteunen bij technische vraagstukken.
  • Adviseren over procesverbeteringen en technische oplossingen.
  • Testen, implementeren en opvolgen van oplossingen bij klanten.
  • Monitoren en optimaliseren van bestaande processen.
  • Opbouwen en onderhouden van langdurige klantrelaties.
  • Samenwerken met commerciële en technische collega’s in België en Nederland.
  • Signaleren van marktontwikkelingen en opportuniteiten.
  • Bachelor of master in Chemie, Chemische Technologie, Procestechnologie of gelijkwaardig door ervaring.
  • Enkele jaren relevante ervaring binnen de chemische sector.
  • Affiniteit met chemische processen en industriële productieomgevingen.
  • Sterke combinatie van technische expertise en commerciële/sociale vaardigheden.
  • Zelfstandig, proactief en zelfsturend.
  • Klantgericht, communicatief sterk en oplossingsgericht.
  • Goede kennis van het Nederlands en Engels. Frans is een plus.

Coordonner les releases, les phases de tests et les mises en production - Assurer une veille fonctionnelle sur le produit nCino et identifier les évolutions pouvant impacter les configurations/développements déjà utilisés par la banque ou pouvant faire l'objet de projets d'évolution apportant de la valeur à la banque - Designer des parcours clients/utilisateurs, mappés sur les fonctionnalités et les capacités techniques, notamment nCino/SalesForce, en tenant compte des processus de la banque et du target operating model et participer à l'établissement d'un backlog supportant ces parcours - Revoir, et le cas échéant proposer, des design nCino/SalesForce supportant les parcours clients/utilisateurs - Proposer une approche d'estimation des développements nCino/SalesForce, intégrant les aspects de spécification, de délai d'implémentation et de qualification - Être rigoureux(se), méthodique et attentif(ve) à la qualité des dossiers traités - Capacité à gérer son stress - Capacité d'apprentissage continu - Capacité d'adaptation au changement - Capacité à communiquer de façon positive et utiliser l'écoute active - Capacité à collaborer et développer l'esprit d'équipe - Maîtrise du français, anglais

title: Ingénieur Sécurité Incendie & Sécurité des Bâtiments (H/F)
description: Harry Hope, cabinet de recrutement accompagne candidats et entreprises dans leurs recherches des meilleures opportunités en France et à l'international. Vous interviendrez sur des projets techniques d'envergure et accompagnerez les maîtres d'ouvrage, architectes et bureaux d'études dans la conception de solutions garantissant la sécurité des personnes et la conformité réglementaire des bâtiments. Réaliser les études techniques liées aux systèmes de protection incendie. Dimensionner les installations de désenfumage, de détection incendie, de sprinklage, de mise en surpression des cages d'escalier ainsi que les autres dispositifs de sécurité des bâtiments. Vérifier la conformité des projets au regard des réglementations luxembourgeoises et des normes européennes en vigueur. Conseiller et accompagner les maîtres d'ouvrage, architectes, bureaux d'études techniques et entreprises tout au long des projets. Participer aux réunions techniques avec les différents intervenants. PROFIL Votre profil Vous êtes titulaire d'un diplôme d'Ingénieur (Bac+5) et justifiez idéalement d'une premier/ière expérience réussie en ingénierie de la sécurité incendie, en techniques spéciales ou en bureau d'études. Vous disposez notamment de solides connaissances dans les domaines suivants : Ingénierie de la sécurité incendie. Sécurité générale des bâtiments. Désenfumage. Détection incendie. Sprinkler. Compartimentage. Évacuation des personnes. Réglementation incendie luxembourgeoise et européenne. Une connaissance des réglementations relatives aux installations d'extinction automatique à eau, aux systèmes de ventilation ou aux techniques spéciales constitue un réel atout. Vous êtes reconnu pour : votre rigueur technique ; votre capacité d'analyse ; votre autonomie ; votre sens du conseil et de la relation client ; vos qualités rédactionnelles. Langues Français courant indispensable. Bon niveau d'anglais. L'allemand et/ou le luxembourgeois constituent un véritable atout.

title: CHARGE D'AFFAIRES EXECUTION RENOVATION (H/F/X)
description: En tant que Chargé(e) d'Affaires Exécution Rénovation, vous prenez le relais des équipes commerciales une fois le projet vendu. Vous êtes responsable de la bonne réalisation des chantiers et veillez au respect des engagements pris auprès du client en matier/ière de qualité, de budget et de délai. Véritable chef d'orchestre du chantier, vous coordonnez les sous-traitants, planifiez les différentes phases de travaux et assurez le suivi des opérations jusqu'à la réception finale. QUI SOMMES NOUS ?Remake fait partie du groupe Reckinger Alfred SA, acteur reconnu au Luxembourg dans les domaines des techniques du bâtiment et de la rénovation.À travers Remake, nous accompagnons les particuliers dans leurs projets de transformation et de rénovation de l'habitat. title: Chef du service facturation et dépenses (m/f/d) (H/F)
description: Qui recrute ?
