Northern Norway offers a unique combination of professional opportunities and quality of life.

You get access to modern healthcare facilities while living close to nature. The region is known for its dramatic landscapes, with mountains, fjords, and coastline right outside your door.

It is a great place for both individuals and families. You will find good schools, safe communities, and a slower, more balanced lifestyle.

Outdoor activities are part of everyday life — whether it is hiking, skiing, fishing, or simply enjoying the Northern Lights in winter and the midnight sun in summer.

Despite the remote location, you have access to regional airports and solid connections to the rest of Norway and Europe.

title: Senior Web Developer
description:
Want to help millions of people think better?

reMarkable makes paper tablets for people who think better on paper. Founded in Oslo in 2013, we’ve created a category of our own: distraction-free devices that combine the feel of pen on paper with the power of digital tools. Our products are used by people all over the world to think, focus and do their best work. We design our hardware, software and services in-house, and we’re a focused, high-ownership team where every role has a direct impact on the product and our customers.

You will be part of the Global ecommerce team, which is responsible for delivering an exceptional shopping experience on remarkable.com, our primary sales channel.

As a Senior Web Developer, you’ll play a key role in building and optimizing our eCommerce platform frontend, from customer experience to internal user experience. Embedded in cross-functional product teams and reporting to the Unit lead, you’ll implement modern designs using a contemporary tech stack, contribute to architectural decisions, champion engineering best practices, and mentor other developers.

Your responsibilities may include

  • Working within cross-functional teams, crafting sophisticated design and modern web that directly engage our users and drive business outcomes

  • Leading the development and optimization of new and existing web applications using our cutting-edge stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Sanity, and the latest in modern tooling. You'll be at the forefront of implementing solutions that are performant, scalable and maintainable

  • Improving our architecture by engaging in critical discussions on software architecture, technology selection, and framework adoption, directly influencing the technical roadmap

  • Cultivating engineering culture, lead by example in code quality, and contribute significantly to our CI initiatives

  • Mentoring junior and mid-level developers, help build a collaborative team that thrives on continuous learning and improvement

  • Enhance the efficiency of business users and enable effective tradeoffs across business and technology

  • Drive and impact business results, by optimizing conversion funnels, building new features and improving site performance to directly impact sales and enhance the customer journey

We are looking for candidates with the following experience

  • 4+ years of software development experience

  • Experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and React in medium to large-sized codebases

  • Experience with Tailwind CSS

  • Experience collaborating and communicating within cross-functional teams, including UX and visual designers, test automation engineers, and product managers

It would also be beneficial if you have

  • Relevant experience in eCommerce, including familiarity with eCommerce engines

  • Experience as a full-stack developer

  • Experience with Sanity

  • University degree in computer science or a related field

(Don't meet every single requirement? We still encourage you to apply!)

Why we enjoy working at reMarkable

  • Encouragement to learn and grow in a collaborative environment that values technical excellence, learning, and modern technology

  • 5 extra paid “reMarkable days” in addition to regular vacation.

  • Premium health insurance, travel insurance, and home broadband coverage

  • A modern campus located central in Oslo, specially designed to reflect reMarkable as a company

  • Access to a free employee gym with top equipment and towels

  • A flexible hybrid work model

  • Wednesday is Zen-day with no internal meetings to create space for you to focus, deepdive and be creative

  • Access to our employee share incentive scheme.

  • Most importantly: We have fun! We have regular events and social gatherings.

Practical information:

  • We will consider applications on a rolling basis

  • Language requirements: Our company language is English

  • Location: Oslo, Norway

  • Visa requirements: Citizenship/valid work permit from the EU/EEA

Om arbeidsgiveren:

reMarkable is on a mission to help people think better through technology in a distracted world. Our paper tablet isn’t just another screen - it’s an experience. We add the warmth of paper to digital solutions, creating something brand new - enabling better thinking through technology. We have sold millions of devices worldwide, wanting to combine the best of the digital and analogue to create tools that enhance learning, focus and presence. To help us get there, we need colleagues that want to make a real difference through their work – and that’s where you come in! Find our current job openings here: https://jobs.remarkable.com/jobs

title: Electronics Engineer
description:
Nofence is a Norwegian scale-up that has built the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock. As we aim to revolutionise livestock management, we will need top-notch competence in our Engineering team, and we are now looking for an Electronics Engineer.

The product is small, solar-assisted and combines GNSS, LTE, Bluetooth, and many other technologies, so every design decision is a system integration problem. Join the NPD team that takes it from concept to pilot production.

What you’ll do

  • Design schematics and PCB layouts, and review designs with the team

  • Bring up new boards, subcircuits and reusable modules

  • Test and validate hardware from first prototype to pilot production

  • Build lab setups and find root causes when things break

  • Work with the embedded team on low power consumption. On a solar-powered device, every microamp counts

What we’re looking for

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s in Electrical Engineering or similar

  • Boards you have taken from schematic to working hardware, and a story about what went wrong on the way

  • Strong fundamentals: analogue, power and digital design, signal integrity, EMC basics, power optimisation

  • Confidence with oscilloscope, spectrum analyser, DMM and PCBA debugging and testing

  • Experience with a professional PCB CAD tool. We’re moving from Altium to KiCad.

  • Fluent English

Nice to have

  • RF and antenna design

  • Experience with integrating GNSS, LTE or Bluetooth in a single device

  • Complex electromechanical products in harsh environments

  • CE, FCC and ISED certification

  • Python for test scripting

What we offer

  • Short path from idea to impact: you’ll see your work in the field

  • Visits to customers and their animals, to see how the product lives in reality

  • Room to grow towards senior or specialist roles

  • Location: Trondheim or Molde

About the Application

We will evaluate candidates continuously. If you have any questions about Nofence or regarding the application, please reach out to our Engineering Manager, Kjetil Grimsæth.

About Nofence

Managing livestock has always been a challenge. Humanity has tried everything from herding with dogs to walling the animals in with barbed wire, electric, and wooden fences, but these are costly and time-consuming solutions and often in conflict with the local wildlife. It has also left vast areas of potential pasture overgrown and underutilized.

Until now.

Enter virtual fences. What started as a small group of farmers and engineers with a big idea has become Nofence – the world’s first virtual fencing solution for livestock.

What we bring to the table

At Nofence, we're not your typical 9-to-5 gig. We're a dynamic scale-up, creating a work atmosphere that's anything but ordinary. It's a place where dedication and innovation are the norm, offering great opportunities for your personal and professional growth.

We believe in seeing results fast. As an engineer with us, your work won't be lost in the bureaucratic shuffle. You'll witness the immediate impact of your contributions in real-time, influencing the evolution of our cutting-edge virtual fencing solution for livestock.

Join us, where ambition meets reality, and let's keep pushing the boundaries in the world of agri-tech!

Vår beiteteknologi skal bidra til at mer av verdens arealressurser kan utnyttes til bærekraftig matproduksjon.En stor andel beitedyr lever mesteparten av livet innendørs og spiser mye kraftfor. Målsettingen til Nofence er å få beitedyra ut på beite, på en trygg og god måte, slik at de kan ha det godt og selv finne den maten de er skapt for å spise.Vi vil at beitedyr skal få muligheten til å ta i bruk sitt naturlige miljø. Det er god dyrevelferd og det vil frigjøre store arealer som kan brukes til å dyrke menneskemat i stedet for soya i kraftforproduksjon.Vår teknologi gir dyra denne muligheten.

title: Systemutvikler
description:
Er du en kreativ og løsningsorientert utvikler som liker å bygge digitale produkter fra idé til ferdig løsning? Har du interesse for AI, moderne webteknologi og entreprenørskap? Da kan dette være en spennende mulighet for deg!

Vi ser etter deg som liker å skape ting, eksperimentere med ny teknologi og ikke minst få løsninger ut i markedet.

💻 Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Utvikle nye webbaserte løsninger og digitale konsepter fra idé til ferdig produkt.

  • Bygge brukervennlige, moderne og funksjonelle kundegrensesnitt.

  • Benytte AI-verktøy aktivt for å effektivisere utviklingsarbeidet.

  • Bidra til tekniske veivalg, arkitektur og videreutvikling av konseptene.

  • Teste, forbedre og videreutvikle løsningene basert på tilbakemeldinger fra brukere og kunder.

🎯 Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi tror du vil trives i rollen dersom du:

  • Har erfaring med utvikling av webbaserte applikasjoner og systemer.

  • Har god forståelse for både frontend og backend.

  • Er komfortabel med moderne utviklingsverktøy og gjerne AI-assistert programmering.

  • Er selvstendig, strukturert og løsningsorientert.

  • Liker å ta eierskap til prosjekter og levere fungerende løsninger.

  • Er nysgjerrig på ny teknologi og ser muligheter i bruk av AI.

Det viktigste for oss er ikke hvilken utdanning du har, men hva du faktisk kan bygge.

Vi ønsker derfor at du som en del av søknaden viser oss eksempler på systemer, nettsider eller applikasjoner du selv har utviklet . Dette kan være egne prosjekter, kundeprosjekter, prototyper eller løsninger du har bygget i forbindelse med studier.

Lenker til GitHub, live-demoer eller en kort beskrivelse av tidligere prosjekter er svært relevant.

Stillingen passer godt for dyktige IT-studenter, selvlærte utviklere eller personer med praktisk utviklingserfaring som ønsker å kombinere fleksibelt arbeid med spennende produktutvikling.

  • 250 kr per time.

  • 100 % remote -- jobb fra der du ønsker.

  • Fleksibel arbeidstid som enkelt kan kombineres med studier.

  • Tilgang til moderne AI-verktøy som kan effektivisere utviklingsarbeidet.

  • Muligheten til å utvikle helt nye digitale konsepter fra bunnen av.

  • Stor teknisk frihet og reell påvirkning på løsningene som utvikles.

  • Sparring med et svært kompetent fagmiljø.

  • Verdifull erfaring med produktutvikling, teknologi og entreprenørskap.

Stilling: Systemutvikler / Fullstack-utvikler

Omfang: 50 % engasjement

Varighet: Ut 2026, med mulighet for forlengelse dersom prosjektene gir ønskede resultater

Arbeidssted: Remote / hjemmekontor

Lønn:250 kr per time

Oppstart: ASAP

Vi ønsker å høre fra deg!

Send oss en kort presentasjon av deg selv, din tekniske bakgrunn og hvorfor du ønsker å jobbe med oss.

Som en del av søknaden ønsker vi at du inkluderer:

  • Eksempler på 1--3 systemer, nettsider eller applikasjoner du har utviklet.

  • En kort beskrivelse av hva du selv har bygget, og hvilke teknologier du har brukt.

title: PhD Candidate in AI for Accelerated Concept and Tender-Phase Ship Design
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 8,6000 employees and 44,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sAbout the position

AI is disrupting how we approach design and engineering. This PhD position is about developing AI methods for reducing the time required for concept evaluation and tender preparation in marine engineering and ship design through rapid estimation, automated data transformation, knowledge graphs and AI-assisted design-space exploration.

We are looking for a PhD candidate who wants to explore and develop AI-based methods for early-stage concept exploration in marine and ship design. The position will develop methods that make concept design faster and better informed: methods that generate and explore design concepts, estimate their performance quickly, and learn from full-scale data. The focus is on early-stage concept exploration and on methods that apply across marine vessels, from ships to uncrewed surface vessels (USVs). A case study will be linked to Fjordlab, part of the Norwegian Ocean Technology Center.

Possible research directions include:

  • AI-based design tools for generating and exploring marine design concepts.
  • How to structure data for effective use in AI design tools.
  • Study how designers and engineers use such tools, and how they affect companies.
  • How full-scale data can drive new concept development.

Are you motivated to take a step towards a doctorate and open up exciting career opportunities? As a PhD Candidate with us, you will work to achieve your doctorate, and at the same time gain valuable experience that qualifies you for a further career in higher education and research, in and outside academia. You will be part of a research environment with several related PhD positions in the Norwegian Maritime AI Centre at NTNU.

Your immediate leader will be the Head of Department.

About the project

The PhD project will be part of the Norwegian Maritime AI Center that aims to accelerate operationalization of AI in the maritime value chains. The center shall position the maritime sector for accelerated and successful use of AI. The demand for safe and sustainable maritime activities, as well as the shortage of crew and engineers, are key drivers for change in the maritime sector. At the same time, there is a pull for growth, increased efficiency and profitability, while managing volatility in the markets. Moreover, the sector is critically important for global supply chains and security in a tense geopolitical situation. To demonstrate and prototype maritime AI solutions, the center will address a diverse and impactful set of use cases: Logistics, shipping and business transactions; Ship design and construction; Voyage planning and optimization; Condition monitoring and maintenance; Crew training; Maritime traffic and ship surveillance; Decarbonization and energy management; Autonomous ships and remote control.

The research partners are the Norwegian University of Science and Technology, (NTNU), University of Oslo, Oslo School of Architecture and Design, Royal Norwegian Naval Academy, Norwegian Mapping Authority, MET and SINTEF Nordvest. There are about 30 user partners from the maritime sector, in addition to hundreds of members of the Maritime Forum, Blue Maritime, Ocean Autonomy, and Maritime CleanTech clusters. The center will be a hub, orchestrating the interfaces with research partners and user partners to facilitate collaboration, knowledge creation, dissemination, innovation, and sharing of knowledge. The Norwegian Maritime AI Center is funded by the Research Council of Norway and the partners for the period 2026-2030. There will be approximately 25 doctoral scholarships and some postdoc positions. More information can be found here: https://www.ntnu.edu/mai

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

Duties of the position
  • Take part in the mandatory PhD research education program obtaining a doctorate
  • Develop research and AI applied to the Maritime Domain, with strong cooperation with the industrial partners
  • Collaborate effectively within the research team, remaining open to constructive feedback throughout the research process
  • Carry out research of good quality within the framework described above
  • Participate actively in discussion with the industrial partners
  • Participate in activities in the Maritime AI center
  • Participate in relevant dissemination activities for the academia and industry
  • Conduct independent research and publish the result in recognized scientific journals and present them at international conferences

Be prepared for changes to your work duties after employment.

Required selection criteria
  • You must meet the requirements for admission to the faculty's Doctoral Programme, see Section 6-1 of the PhD regulations for more information.
  • You must have a relevant Master's degree in mechanical engineering, product design, marine engineering, naval architecture or a closely related field or equivalent. Your degree must include a major independent project (minimum 30 ECTS) equivalent to a master’s thesis. Degrees from other engineering disciplines such as computer science or mechatronics are also welcome to apply.
  • Master students can apply, but the master's degree must be obtained and documented before starting the position.
  • You must have a strong and relevant academic background from your previous studies and have an average grade from your Master's degree study, or equivalent education, which is equal to B or better compared to NTNU's grading scale. If you do not have letter grades from previous studies, you must have an equally good academic foundation. If you have a weaker academic background, you may be considered if you can document that you are exceptionally suited for a PhD education, for example through relevant work experience and/or peer-reviewed academic works.
  • Affinity with programming, AI-related tools and a desire to work with the development of applied computational tools
  • Excellent oral and written presentation skills in English

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Preferred selection criteria
  • Experience applying machine learning or generative AI to engineering design problems.
  • Experience with CAD and parametric modelling.
  • Experience with simulation, sensors, data acquisition or field testing.
  • Experience with marine vessels, USVs or other marine engineering systems.
  • Interest in design methodology and how engineers reason and make decisions.
Personal characteristics

To complete a doctoral degree (PhD), it is important that you are able to: 

  • Work independently
  • Work in a structured way, set goals and make plans to achieve them, also when the path is unclear
  • Show curiosity and enjoy combining building things with writing code.
  • Present and discuss your research with other engineers, researchers and industry partners
  • Get involved and contribute constructively with feedback
  • Enjoy working both in the lab and in the field, including tests at sea.
  • Analyze data, assess different perspectives and draw well-founded conclusions 
  • Be flexible and open to adjusting the plan for the project as needed

Emphasis will be placed on personal qualities.

We offer
  • An exciting job with an important mission in society
  • Developing tasks in a strong and international professional environment
  • Open and inclusive working environment with committed colleagues
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • Mentor programme as a new employee at NTNU
  • Favorable terms as a member of the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund (SPK)
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)

As a PhD Candidate at NTNU, you will have access to employee benefits.

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. (delete if not applicable)

Salary and conditions

In the position of PhD Candidate, code 1017, your gross salary will normally be NOK 580 000,-per annum depending on qualifications and seniority. A 2% statutory contribution to the State Pension Fund is deducted from the salary. 

The employment period is 3 years for the doctoral work.

For employment as a PhD Candidate, it is a prerequisite that you gain admission to the PhD programme in Engineering within three months of your employment contract start date, and that you participate in an organized doctoral programme through out the period of employment.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important that you keep yourself up to date with academic and organizational changes and adapt to them.

For the necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to bein conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

About the application

The attachments (including a description of your scientific work) must accompany the application as these documents form the basis of the application assessment. The documents must be in Norwegian/a Scandinavian language or English.

Please note: the application will only be assessed on the basis of the information we have received by the application deadline. Therefore, make sure that your application clearly shows how your skills and experience meet the criteria described above. The application and all attachments must be sent electronically via Jobbnorge.no. If you are invited to an interview, you must bring certified copies of certificates and diplomas upon request.

The application must include:

  • Transcripts and diplomas for Bachelor's and Master's degrees
  • CV 
  • Copy or short summary of Master's thesis. If you have recently submitted your Master's thesis, you can attach a draft of the thesis. Documentation of a completed Master's degree must be presented before taking up the position.
  • Project outline containing proposals for an overall description of research questions, theoretical perspectives, methodological design for the project and progress plan (maximum 1500 words/4 pages) 
  • Short letter of motivation (400 words/1 page)
  • Possibly publications etc. other relevant research work
  • Possibly certificates
  • Names and contact information of three relevant referees

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act, and Export control (legislation that regulates the export of knowledge, technology and services). Candidates who, after assessment of the application and attachments, are considered to be in conflict with the criteria in the latter act, will not be able to be employed.

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.

Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU recognizes a wide range of academic contributions and has committed itself to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment and CoARA (responsible assessment of research and recognition of a greater breadth of academic contributions in accordance with NTNU's social mission).

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Associate Professor Øystein Bjelland, email: oystein.bjelland@ntnu.no

If you have any questions about the recruitment process, please contact PhD Coordinator Lara Bromann, email: lara.bromann@ntnu.no

Application deadline: 22.11.2026

-----------------

  • Er rolig, tålmodig og behersket, også i utfordrende situasjoner.

  • Håndterer stress og arbeider effektivt under press.

  • Er nøyaktig, strukturert og ansvarsbevisst.

  • Har høy integritet og behandler fortrolige opplysninger med diskresjon.

  • Arbeider selvstendig og tar initiativ innenfor eget ansvarsområde.

  • Er løsningsorientert og håndterer uforutsette situasjoner på en profesjonell måte.

  • Har gode samarbeidsevner og kommuniserer tydelig og respektfullt med både beboere og kolleger.

Arbeidsoppgaver

Arbeidsoppgaver

1. Beboerøkonomi

  • Administrere og følge opp beboernes økonomiske ytelser.

  • Beregne og kontrollere utbetalinger i henhold til gjeldende satser og retningslinjer.

  • Sørge for korrekt og rettidig utbetaling av økonomiske ytelser.

  • Registrere og dokumentere alle utbetalinger.

  • Kontrollere utbetalingslister, kvitteringer og økonomiske bilag.

  • Følge opp endringer i beboernes situasjon som påvirker økonomiske ytelser.

  • Utarbeide oversikter og rapporter knyttet til beboerøkonomi.

2. Refusjonskrav til UDI

  • Utarbeide, kontrollere og sende refusjonskrav til UDI i henhold til gjeldende rutiner og frister.

  • Kontrollere at utgifter som kreves refundert, er dokumentert og oppfyller gjeldende vilkår.

  • Sikre at nødvendig dokumentasjon, bilag og kvitteringer vedlegges refusjonskravene.

  • Følge opp innsendte refusjonskrav og eventuelle spørsmål eller tilbakemeldinger fra UDI.

  • Registrere og følge opp godkjente, avslåtte og utestående refusjonskrav.

  • Bidra til god intern økonomikontroll og korrekt rapportering av refusjonsberettigede utgifter.

3. Generelle administrative oppgaver

  • Sikre forsvarlig arkivering og behandling av økonomiske opplysninger.

  • Følge opp økonomiske avvik og bidra til gode interne kontrollrutiner.

  • Samarbeide tett med mottaksleder og øvrige ansatte.

  • Gi beboerne nødvendig informasjon om økonomiske ytelser og utbetalingsrutiner.

Vi tilbyr

Vi tilbyr

  • En meningsfull stilling i et viktig samfunnsoppdrag.

  • Varierte arbeidsoppgaver med et tydelig ansvarsområde.

  • Et inkluderende og engasjert arbeidsmiljø.

  • Muligheten til å bidra til god økonomisk forvaltning og forsvarlig drift av mottaket.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Lilandtunet AS

Lilandtunet AS er et norsk selskap med base i Voss, Vestland. Selskapet har bakgrunn fra hotell- og gjestfrihetsbransjen, men har tilpasset sin virksomhet til å tilby innkvartering for asylsøkere.

I dag driver Lilandtunet AS Voss ordinære asylmottak på oppdrag fra Utlendingsdirektoratet (UDI), gjennom en inngått driftsavtale. Selskapet er opptatt av å tilby trygge, verdige og forsvarlige boforhold, og å skape et inkluderende og godt miljø for beboerne, samtidig som virksomheten drives på en profesjonell og ansvarlig måte.

title: Bli vår nye mekaniker i Ålesund – frihet, faglige utfordringer og et rått team!
description:
Er du en dyktig mekaniker som brenner for at maskiner skal fungere 100 %, yte maksimalt og se skikkelige ut? Motiveres du av varierte dager, god tillit og friheten til å legge opp din egen hverdag slik at arbeidet flyter best mulig? Da vil du trives hos oss i Cramo.

 

Hos oss blir du ikke bare en som skrur, du får det reelle ansvaret for at utleieparken i Ålesund spiller på lag. Verkstedet og maskinparken blir ditt stolte ansvarsområde, hvor du får styre prosessene, planlegge kapasiteten og ta de faglige avgjørelsene som utgjør en forskjell. Du får en nøkkelrolle med stor handlingsfrihet, samtidig som du blir en del av et uformelt og faglig sterkt team som deler erfaringer og mener at god humor er like viktig som godt håndverk.

 

Hva tilbyr vi deg?

Vi vet at en avdeling kun fungerer bra når folk trives. Derfor legger vi alt til rette for en forutsigbar og god hverdag med lavt stressnivå, selv når det koker litt ekstra.

 

  • Stor tillit og faglig eierskap: Du får styre hverdagen din i stor grad selv og ta avgjørelser som påvirker driften direkte.
  • Et sterkt fagmiljø å sparre med: Du står aldri alene! Teamet i Ålesund, sammen med erfarne mekanikere i resten av regionen, samarbeider tett og deler gladelig av sin erfaring.
  • Gode betingelser: Konkurransedyktig lønn, attraktiv bonusordning og solid pensjons- og forsikringspakke.
  • Balanse og trivsel: Vi har fokus på trivsel og at du har det bra både på og utenfor jobb. Du får støtte til trening og én betalt frivillighetsdag i året.
  • Uformell kultur: En «klart vi kan»-holdning med rom for god humor og høyt under taket.

 

Hva innebærer rollen hos oss?

Som mekaniker hos Cramo i Ålesund tar du styringen over arbeidshverdagen. Du sørger for at maskinene våre er funksjonelle, godt vedlikeholdt og fremstår visuelt flotte for kundene våre.

 

Dine viktigste oppgaver vil være:

  • Helhetlig eierskap til maskinparken: Feilsøking, service, reparasjoner og klargjøring før, under og etter utleie.
  • Styre kapasitet og innkjøp: Du vurderer arbeidsmengden fortløpende. Ved topper, servicer eller årskontroller har du mandat til å koordinere med eksterne leverandører/mekanikere.
  • Prosess- og kostnadskontroll: Du styrer hele reparasjonsløpet fra feilsøking til registrering og kostnadsføring på serviceordre, slik at drift kan fakturere reelle reparasjonskostnader videre.
  • Verksteddrift: Holde orden i delebestillinger, optimalisere verksteddriften og redusere antall maskiner som står «nede».
  • Utrykninger og feltoppdrag: Noen dager jobber du på verkstedet, andre dager drar du ut til kunden og blir helten som løser utfordringene på stedet.

 

 

Hvem ser vi etter?

Vi leter ikke etter en superhelt som kan alt fra dag en, men etter deg som brenner for mekaniker faget, liker å ha oversikt og har god teknisk forstand. Du stolt av jobben du gjør, enten du løser en kompleks feilkode eller sørger for at en maskin ser skinnende ny ut for neste kunde.

 

Det er ideelt om du har:

  • Fagbrev innen anleggs-, landbruks- eller industrimekanikk, elektro (Gr. L) eller et annet relevant mekanisk fag.
  • …men har du lang, praktisk erfaring og en "skru-hjerne" som løser det meste? Søk likevel! Hos oss veier reell kompetanse, faglig engasjement og rett innstilling veldig høyt.
  • Førerkort klasse B (har du BE eller truckførerbevis er det en fin bonus. Har du det ikke, så finner vi ut av det sammen).

  • Grunnleggende digitale ferdigheter og gode norskkunnskaper.

     

Du er en vi passe sammen med dersom du:

  • Motiveres av tillit og frihet under ansvar, og liker å ha kontroll på egne prosjekter og kostnader.
  • Trives med at det koker litt ekstra i ny og ne, men mestrer kunsten å holde hodet kaldt slik at det aldri oppleves som uoversiktlig stress.
  • Er en utpreget lagspiller som bryr seg om kollegene sine, sprer god stemning i kaffepausene og skaper en trygg, inkluderende arbeidsplass.

 

Klar for nye utfordringer?

Send oss en søknad eller ta kontakt for en uforpliktende prat om rollen! Vi gleder oss til å bli kjent med deg.

 

 

 

 

For mer informasjon eller spørsmål, kontakt oss på:

Mail: Richard.taylor@randstad.noMobil: 982 95 163

For å søke:Registrer din CV online på www.randstad.no og søk på denne stillingen.

  • Søknadsfrist - Senest 16.11.26. (Ansettelse kan bli gjort før frist)

Alle søkere vil få svar og blir kontaktet.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Cramo er et av Norges ledende utleieselskaper innen maskiner, utstyr og modulbygg for bygg, anlegg, industri og offentlig sektor. Vi har over 30 avdelinger, mer enn 300 ansatte og er sertifisert innen kvalitet, miljø og arbeidsmiljø (ISO 9001, 14001 og 45001).

Siden 2020 har Cramo vært en del av Boels Rental, en av Europas største og mest fremtidsrettede 

aktører innen utleiebransjen. Dette gir oss et solid apparat i ryggen og gode forutsetninger for videre utvikling.

I vår avdeling jobber vi målrettet for å levere de beste løsningene i markedet, med høy aktivitet, tett samarbeid med både små og store kunder, og et fremoverlent arbeidsmiljø preget av kontinuerlig utvikling og varierte arbeidsoppgaver.

title: PhD Candidate in Optimization and Decision Support for Resilient Transport Systems
description:
This is NTNU

NTNU is a broad-based university with a technical-scientific profile and a focus in professional education. The university is located in three cities with headquarters in Trondheim.

At NTNU, 8,6000 employees and 44,000 students work to create knowledge for a better world.

You will find more information about working at NTNU and the application process here.   

Video: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=_KHQjc4ndas&t=41sBackground

We invite applications for a 4-year PhD Candidate position focused on optimization and decision-support methods for resilient transport systems. The position is based at the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management, located at NTNU’s campus in Trondheim.

The mission of Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management is to carry out education and research activities at a high international level in the intersection between technology/natural sciences and business economics, management, and HSE to promote sustainable value creation in technology-based areas in industry, business, and public sector organizations in Norway.

About the position

Transport systems can be disrupted by events such as floods, landslides, traffic accidents, and technical failures. These disruptions can close or constrain links in the transport network, affecting the movement of passengers and goods.

This PhD project will develop optimization methods to support strategic and operational decisions in multimodal transport systems. Strategic decisions may include infrastructure investments, resource placement, and infrastructure reinforcement. Operational decisions may include rerouting traffic, allocating capacity, and planning recovery.

You will work closely with another PhD candidate who is developing dynamic transport models and machine-learning methods to predict how the network performs under different conditions. You will integrate these models into optimization methods, allowing, for example, many scenarios and resilience measures to be evaluated efficiently.

The project addresses research questions like:

  • How can optimization support strategic investment and resource-allocation decisions for resilient transport systems?
  • How can dynamic transport models and machine-learning methods improve optimization across many possible scenarios?
  • How can optimization support rerouting, capacity allocation, and recovery decisions when parts of a transport system are unavailable?

The PhD candidate will develop models for strategic resilience planning and operational disruption management. The research will examine how to balance efficiency, redundancy, recovery, and societal requirements.

Use cases will be developed in close collaboration with project partners, including Norway’s railway infrastructure manager (Bane NOR), the Norwegian Public Roads Administration (Statens vegvesen), and the Norwegian Defence Research Establishment (FFI). The candidate will work with partners to examine practical decisions related to transport resilience.

The position offers an opportunity to develop optimization methods for important decisions about transport resilience, in collaboration with researchers in optimization, machine learning, transport modelling, infrastructure, and social sciences.

Research environment

The PhD position is part of STRIDE: Synergizing Transport Resilience, Infrastructure, and Defense in Extremes, an interdisciplinary research project involving researchers in transport modelling, machine learning, optimization, infrastructure, and social sciences.

The project studies how transport systems respond to disruptions and how modelling and decision-support methods can strengthen resilience across planning, response, and recovery. The PhD candidate will work closely with three other PhD candidates studying interdependent hazards, data-driven modelling of multimodal transport, and the societal dimensions of resilience and total defense.

The PhD candidate will be hosted at the Managerial Economics, Finance and Operations Research (BEDØK) group at the Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management. The group is one of Norway’s leading academic environments in operations research, logistics, optimization, and quantitative decision support. The candidate will work in close collaboration with researchers from NTNU’s Department of Computer Science and Department of Civil and Environmental Engineering.

Your role in the project
  • Conduct original scientific research related to the project topic
  • Develop optimization models and decision-support methods for resilient transport systems
  • Publish research results in leading international journals and conferences
  • Collaborate with academic and industry partners
  • Integrate dynamic transport models and machine-learning surrogates developed in a parallel PhD project into optimization methods
  • Complete the required coursework as part of the PhD programme
  • Contribute to dissemination and communication of research results
Required selection criteria
  • Applicants must hold a master’s degree in a relevant field with strong academic results (B or better according to NTNU's grading scale). Relevant academic backgrounds include:
    • Operations research or optimization
    • Applied mathematics
    • Industrial engineering
    • Transport or logistics
    • Engineering disciplines with strong quantitative and analytical content
  • Applicants must document competence in mathematical optimization, operations research, and/or related quantitative methods.
  • The position requires excellent English oral and writing skills.  

The appointment is to be made in accordance with NTNUs guidelines for recruitment positions for general criteria for the position.

Desired qualifications

The following qualifications will be considered an advantage:

  • Good knowledge of mathematical optimization, such as mixed-integer programming, stochastic programming, or robust optimization
  • Experience with optimization under uncertainty
  • Experience with algorithm development
  • Proficiency in at least one programming language, e.g, Python, Julia, C++, or similar
  • Knowledge of machine learning 

Applicants in the final phase of their master’s studies are encouraged to apply.

Personal characteristics

Personal characteristics

We are looking for a candidate who:

  • Is intellectually curious and motivated to conduct high-quality research
  • Works independently and in a structured manner
  • Has strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Thrives in interdisciplinary research environments
  • Is interested in developing research with practical relevance and societal impact

Emphasis will be placed on scientific quality, research potential, and personal suitability.

We offer
  • An exciting and international academic environment with opportunities for competence development 
  • Opportunities to collaborate with researchers in optimization, machine learning, transport modelling, and infrastructure
  • Close interaction with industry partners and public sector stakeholders
  • Participation in an interdisciplinary research project on resilient transport systems
  • Opportunities for research stays at international universities
  •  follow-up during the PhD period
  • Working capital that can be used to implement the project
  • An open and inclusive workplace  with engaged colleagues 
  • Favorable terms in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund
  • Employee benefits
  • Good loan, insurance, and pension schemes in the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund 
  • Free Norwegian language training at a basic level (A2)
  • Working at NTNU

Information about working and living in Norway can be found at the following link: https://www.workinnorway.no/en/Home

Diversity

Diversity is a strength, and at NTNU we aim to be an employer that reflects the diversity in society and that makes use of the potential of the population's collective skills. Our vision is Knowledge for a better world and our values ​​are creative, critical, constructive and respectful. We believe that an organization that is equal, diverse and gender-balanced is essential for us to achieve our goals. 

We strive to attract employees with different skills, life experiences and perspectives to contribute to even better problem solving of our societal mission in research and education. 

If you think this position is relevant and interesting, we encourage you to apply, regardless of gender, functional ability and cultural background, or whether you have been out of work for a period of time.

At NTNU we want to increase the proportion of women in scientific positions. We have a number of measures to promote equality. 

Salary and conditions

PhD candidates are remunerated in code 1017, currently NOK 580.000,- per year before tax. From the salary, 2% is deducted as a contribution to the Norwegian Public Service Pension Fund.

The employment period is 4 years, of which 3 years is for the doctoral work and 1 year for career enhancing work, such as, teaching and supervision activities.

Appointment requires admission to the PhD programme at the Faculty of Economics and Management at NTNU.Trondheim is the workplace. For necessary professional and social interaction, it is a prerequisite that you are physically present and available to the institution on a daily basis.

The position is connected to the PhD program at the Faculty of Economics and Management, and the faculty will be your employer. Appointment to a PhD position requires that you are admitted to the PhD programme in Industrial Economics and Technology Management within three months of employment, and that you participate in an organized PhD programme during the employment period.

The appointment is carried out in accordance with the principles of the State Employees Act.Any statutory leave will be added to the employment period.

As an employee at NTNU, it is important to stay updated on professional and organizational changes and adapt to these.

About the application

Please note that the application will only be assessed based on the information we have at the application deadline. Therefore, ensure that your application clearly demonstrates how your skills and experiences meet the criteria described above.

The application must contain the following: 

  • Motivation letter – The motivation letter must clearly state how the candidate meets the qualification requirements.
  • Research plan (maximum one page) – Applicants should provide a brief research plan describing how they would approach one or more of the research questions outlined in the description of the position. The plan should reflect the applicant’s research interests and provide an outline of how they envision contributing to the project objectives.
  • CV, diplomas, and certificates 
  • Scientific works, including the master thesis. 
  • Names and contact information of three potential references

If all, or parts, of your education has been taken abroad, we also ask you to attach documentation of the scope and quality of your entire education, both Bachelor's and Master's education, in addition to other higher education. If your institution uses “diploma supplement” (normal for most European institutions), you must attach this. A description of the documentation required can also be found here. If you already have a statement from Norwegian Directorate for Higher Education and Skills (HK-dir), please attach this as well.Joint work will be considered. If it is difficult to identify your contribution to joint work, you must attach a brief description of your participation.

When assessing the best qualified, we emphasize necessary qualifications such as education, experience and personal suitability. Motivation for the position, ambitions, and potential for research will also count when assessing the candidates.NTNU is committed to following the evaluation criteria for research quality according to The San Francisco Declaration on Research Assessment – DORA and the commitments in CoARA (responsible research assessment and recognition of a broader range of academic contributions in line with NTNU's societal mission).

Incomplete applications will not be considered.

General information

A public list of applicants with name, age, job title and municipality of residence is prepared after the application deadline. If you wish to be exempt from entry on the public applicant list, this must be justified. Assessment will be made in accordance with current legislation. You will be notified if the exemption is not granted.

If you think this position looks interesting and in line with your qualifications, you are welcome to apply.

Questions about the position can be directed to Associate Professor Steffen Jaap Skotvoll Bakker, steffen.bakker@ntnu.no.

If you have any questions regarding the employment process, please contact HR Advisor Hilde Selli Egelie at hilde.s.egelie@ntnu.no.

An application including attachments should be sent electronically through www.jobbnorge.no

Application deadline: 20.11.2026 

The city of Trondheim is a modern European city with a rich cultural scene. Trondheim is the tech capital of Norway with a population of 200,000. The Norwegian welfare state, including healthcare, schools, kindergartens and overall equality, is probably the best of its kind in the world. Professional subsidized day-care for children is easily available. Furthermore, Trondheim offers great opportunities for education (including international schools) and possibilities to enjoy nature, culture and family life and has low crime rates and clean air quality. 

Om arbeidsgiveren:

NTNU - knowledge for a better world

The Norwegian University of Science and Technology (NTNU) creates knowledge for a better world and solutions that can change everyday life.

Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management

We conduct research and teaching at an international level in the interface between technology/natural sciences and economics, management, and HSE (health, safety and the environment). Our goal is sustainable creation of value within technology-based areas in industry, business and the public sector in Norway. We have academic groups in Trondheim and Gjøvik. The Department of Industrial Economics and Technology Management is one of four departments in the Faculty of Economics and Management.

title: PhD Research Fellow in Planetary Atmospheric Chemistry utilizing Quantum Chemistry
description:
About the position

We invite applications for a PhD Research Fellow position in Planetary Atmospheric Chemistry utilizing Quantum Chemistry, available at Department of Chemistry, theoretical chemistry section.

Starting date as soon as possible and no later than 01.03.2027 . The fellowship period is three years.

A fourth year maybe considered and it will involve 25 percent of other career-promoting work. Other career-promoting work may consist of teaching, supervision, and/or research assistance. This is dependent upon the qualification of the applicant and the current needs of the department.

No one can be appointed for more than one PhD Research Fellowship period at the University of Oslo. 

Place of work is The Life Science Building at Blindern, Oslo.

Project description

A PhD position is available at the Section for Theoretical Chemistry, Department of Chemistry, University of Oslo, within the project Molecular Atmospheric Chemistry on Alien Worlds (MACAW), funded by the Research Council of Norway.In this project we will employ quantum chemistry methods using high-performance computing (HPC) resources to study chemical reactions, photochemistry, identify spectral signatures for potential detection and elucidate condensation mechanisms for molecules in atmospheres beyond that of contemporary Earth. The project has a particular focus on Sulfur and Chlorine chemistry as well as isotopic fractionation processes.The successful applicant will have freedom to pursue specific research topics within the relatively wide project framework, in coordination with the supervisor. The work is first and foremost computational utilizing electronic structure methods to qualitatively study photochemical and thermal reaction mechanisms, as well as quantify reaction rates, UV-Vis spectra and other molecular properties relevant to studying the role of molecules in planetary atmospheres.

The work has a high degree of international collaboration within the main project supervisors' network currently spanning four continents among seven nations. This is to ensure maximal dissemination and impact of the project results, and thus the project will likely involve more than a usual amount of both hosting international visitors and travel to visit our collaborators.The project work is highly flexible, allowing the successful candidate to structure their own work.This project is an excellent opportunity for a prospective PhD candidate to make original and foundational contributions to the field of planetary atmospheric chemistry, with the potential for leading to groundbreaking discoveries of new molecules or chemical processes on other planets.

What skills are important in this role?

The Faculty of Mathematics and Natural Sciences has a strategic ambition to be among Europe’s leading communities for research, education and innovation. Candidates for these fellowships will be selected in accordance with this, and expected to be in the upper segment of their class with respect to academic credentials.

Required qualifications:

  • Master’s degree or equivalent in chemistry, physics, nanoscience or related fields. Foreign completed degree (M.Sc.-level) corresponding to a minimum of four years in the Norwegian educational system
  • Fluent oral and written communication skills in English.
  • Relevant experience in utilizing computational resources and code for simulations of molecular properties
  • Experience with quantum chemistry calculations
  • Experience with scripting or programming (e.g. Python, Bash, Matlab, Fortran), and high-performance computing 

Desired qualifications:

  • Experience in electronic structure methods, e.g. DFT, coupled cluster or multireference methods
  • Background in chemical kinetics, reaction mechanisms, photochemistry, spectroscopy, transition state theory, atmospheric chemistry and/or physical chemistry
  • Any insights into planetary/exoplanetary science and photochemical atmospheric modeling 

Language requirement:

  • Good oral and written communication skills in English
  • English requirements for applicants from outside of EU/ EEA countries and exemptions from the requirements:https://www.mn.uio.no/english/research/phd/regulations/regulations.html#toc8

Grade requirements:The norm is as follows:

  • The average grade point for courses included in the Bachelor’s degree must be C or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The average grade point for courses included in the Master’s degree must be B or better in the Norwegian educational system
  • The Master’s thesis must have the grade B or better in the Norwegian educational system

For more information see:

The purpose of the fellowship is research training leading to the successful completion of a PhD degree. 

What are we looking for in you?

Personal skills:

  • A fundamental drive for scientific research, keenness/eagerness in challenging work with limited repetitiveness which requires continued learning
  • A strong interest in atmospheric, planetary and/or exoplanet science
  • Ability to work both independently and as part of an international, interdisciplinary team
  • Ability to work precise in a structured manner and swiftly adapts to new tasks. The work is very flexible which requires discipline
  • Direct communication skills and excellent collaboration
  • Positive attitude and the ability to handle hectic periods

Employment in the position is based on a comprehensive assessment of all qualification requirements applicable to the position, including personal qualifications.

We can offer you
  • Exciting and meaningful tasks in an organization with an important societal mission, contributing to knowledge development, education, and enlightenment that promote sustainable, fair, and knowledge-based societal development.
  • Committed colleagues in a good working environment. 
  • Good welfare schemes
  • Opportunity of up to 1.5 hours a week of exercise during working hours
  • A workplace with good development and career opportunities
  • Career development programmes
  • Membership in the Statens Pensjonskasse, which is one of Norway's best pension schemes with beneficial mortgages and good insurance schemes
  • Oslo’s family-friendly surroundings with their rich opportunities for culture and outdoor activities
  • Salary in position as PhD Research Fellow, position code 1017 in salary range NOK from 550 800 - 595 000, depending on competence and experience. From the salary, 2 percent is deducted in statutory contributions to the State Pension Fund 
We need different perspectives in our work

UiO is an open and internationally oriented comprehensive university that strives to be an inclusive and diverse workplace and academic environment. You can read more about UiO’s work on equality, inclusion, and diversity at uio.no.

We fulfill our mission most effectively when we draw upon our variety of experiences, backgrounds, and perspectives. We are looking for great colleagues, could you be the next one?

We will do our best to accommodate your needs. Relevant adjustments may include modifications to working hours, task adaptations, digital, technical, or physical adjustments, or other practical measures.

If you have an immigrant background, a disability, or CV gaps (Norwegian), we encourage you to indicate this in the job application portal. We always invite at least one qualified candidate from each group for an interview. In this context, disability is defined as an applicant who identifies as having a disability that requires workplace or employment-related accommodations. For more details about the requirements, please refer to the Employer portal (Norwegian).

The selections made in the job application portal are used for anonymized statistics that all state employers include in their annual reports. More information about gender equality initiatives at UiO can be found here. We hope you will apply for the position with us.

How to apply

The application must include:

  • Cover letter - statement of motivation and research interests
  • CV (summarizing education, positions and academic work - scientific publications)
  • Copies of the original Bachelor and Master’s degree diploma and transcripts of records (see below)
  • Documentation of English Language requirements. The appointed candidate cannot start in the position until approved documentation of English language proficiency has been submitted.
  • List of publications and academic work that the applicant wishes to be considered by the evaluation committee
  • Names and contact details of 2-3 references (name, relation to candidate, e-mail and telephone number)

title: Facility Technical Sr. Manager
description:
About Nordscale

Nordscale is the specialist operator for mission-critical AI data centers. We manage the operations that keep AI compute sites running reliably, efficiently, and safely. Founded as a strategic partnership between the AI hyperscaler Nscale and Norwegian energy company Nordkraft, we harness local expertise and data center operations experience to deliver service excellence to our customers, while building skilled local jobs and partnering with Norwegian businesses to create lasting value in the regions where we work.

 

Our culture combines local Northern Norwegian values, international expertise, and disciplined operational excellence. We’re a team built on trust, ownership, and collaboration: we communicate openly, take accountability for outcomes, and work as one team across sites, partners, and functions to deliver performance people can depend on.

 

About the Role (Job Purpose)

As Facility Technical Senior Manager, you will lead the technical MEP unit at Kvandal South outside Narvik, one of the largest AI data-centre projects in Europe. You will be central in building the unit ahead of the start of operations. You will make sure the facility’s electrical, mechanical, cooling, automation and cabling infrastructure is operated, maintained and developed safely and reliably.

 

You will report to the Facility Director and lead through an Associate Facility Technical Manager, shift managers, a project manager, technical specialists and operational support functions. Additionally, you will hold technical authority within the unit.

 

 

What You’ll be Doing (Responsibilities)
  • Recruit and build the unit. Establish a structured training programme and knowledge transfer to the full technical operations team.
  • Lead technical operations around the clock, ensure adequate staffing and the right mix of competencies across all shifts to support 24/7 operations.
  • Manage preventive and corrective maintenance, and lead the technical response and fault-finding during critical incidents.
  • Participate in testing, commissioning and handover of technical installations together with Nscale. Lead the development and implementation of technical operating procedures (SOP/MOP/EOP) and governance structures, and establish technical supplier agreements.
  • Ensure safe working methods and full HSE compliance, and manage technical suppliers and contractors on quality, documentation, performance and cost.

 

About You (Skills, Qualifications & Experience)

You may come from data centres, hyperscale or HPC facilities. You may also come from technical or production leadership in continuous process industry, metallurgy, pulp and paper, power generation, offshore, maritime operations or technical defence environments. A career path from an electrical, automation or mechanical specialist role into technical or maintenance leadership is particularly valuable.

You enjoy developing people, share knowledge patiently and build ownership of procedures. You drive continuous improvement through structured processes, not by departing from them.

 

Key Characteristics

  • Structured and systematic, thriving where structures, roles and requirements are clearly defined.
  • Acts in compliance with procedures, standards and regulatory requirements, and holds others to the same standard.
  • Resilient under pressure, building relationships of trust and finding pragmatic, holistic solutions.

 

Skills & Qualifications

  • Solid experience leading the operation and maintenance of complex electrical, mechanical and cooling infrastructure, with the technical depth to challenge specialists and suppliers.
  • Experience leading and developing multidisciplinary technical teams, preferably with both day and shift teams.
  • Experience with procedures, work permits, safe isolation, change management and supplier management. Experience from testing, commissioning and handover is an advantage.
  • Fluent English and a Scandinavian language, written and spoken. A degree in electrical, mechanical or automation engineering, or equivalent documented engineering background, is preferred.

 

What We Can Offer You
  • Competitive salary negotiable based on experience. 
  • Performance-based bonus tied to results and company performance. 
  • The chance to build the technical organisation, procedures and training from the ground up, and to bring Kvandal South’s technical systems into operation in 2027.
  • Relocation support assessed individually, if required. 

 

Equal Opportunities Statement

We are committed to fostering an inclusive, diverse, and equitable workplace. We believe that a variety of perspectives enriches our work environment, and we encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities.  We strongly encourage applications from people of colour, the LGBTQ+ community, people with disabilities, neurodivergent people, parents, carers, and people from lower socio-economic backgrounds.

 

If there’s anything we can do to accommodate your specific situation, please let us know.

title: Thon Hotel Straume søker Salgssjef
description:
Salgssjef Konferanse & Bedriftsmarked

Bli med og bygg Vestlandets nye møteplass før dørene åpner!

Thon Hotel Straume | The Coastal Conference City

På Straume, bare minutter fra Bergen sentrum, bygger vi nå et av regionens mest spennende hotell- og konferanse.

I første kvartal 2029 åpner nye Thon Hotel Straume med 189 hotellrom, kapasitet for 700 konferansegjester og en storsal for opptil 300 personer.

Her får du oppleve en destinasjon hvor kystens rå energi møter byens puls og en spennende møteplass og konferansedestinasjon.

Vi kaller det The Coastal Conference City.

Nå ser vi etter salgssjefen som skal være med å bygge markedet lenge før bygget står ferdig.

Er du komfortabel med å selge en visjon?

Dette er ikke en tradisjonell salgsrolle.

De neste årene skal du fylle ordreboken for et hotell og konferanseanlegg som fortsatt er under bygging. Du må klare å få kunder til å se det vi ser. Du må kunne tegne bildene, fortelle historien og skape entusiasme for en destinasjon som vokser frem måned for måned.

Vi ser etter deg som tror på prosjektet, ser mulighetene i Øygarden og evner å gjøre våre fremtidige gjester like begeistret som vi er.

Du blir en sentral del av prosjektet og får følge utviklingen fra byggeplass til ferdig destinasjon samt en del av hotellets ledergruppe.

Hva skal du gjøre?

Du får ansvaret for å etablere og utvikle konferanse- og bedriftsmarkedet for nye Thon Hotel Straume.

Dette innebærer blant annet å:

  • Bygge og utvikle en solid portefølje av bedriftskunder og samarbeidspartnere

  • Selge møter, konferanser, arrangementer og hotellavtaler flere år frem i tid

  • Bygge opp ordreboken mot åpningen i 2029

  • Utvikle relasjoner innen MICE-markedet (Meetings, Incentives, Conferences & Events)

  • Jobbe med hotellavtaler, prosjektavtaler og langsiktige rammeavtaler

  • Gjennomføre kundemøter, presentasjoner, nettverksaktiviteter og befaringer

  • Samarbeide tett med drift, booking og ledelse om produkter, konsepter og kommersiell utvikling

  • Være en ambassadør for både Thon Hotel Straume, The Coastal Conference City og destinasjonen Øygarden

Hvem ser vi etter?

Du er en relasjonsbygger som motiveres av å åpne dører og skape nye muligheter.

Du trives når målet ligger langt fremme, og du lar deg ikke stoppe av at bygget fortsatt er under oppføring.

Kanskje jobber du allerede med hotellsalg, konferansesalg eller annen kompleks B2B-salg. Kanskje kommer du fra reiseliv, opplevelser eller prosjektbasert salg.

Det viktigste er at du:

  • Har dokumenterte resultater innen salg

  • Trives med oppsøkende salgsarbeid

  • Er strukturert og god på langsiktig oppfølging

  • Evner å bygge tillit og relasjoner på alle nivåer

  • Har kommersiell forståelse og ser verdien i gode kundeavtaler

  • Er en inspirerende historieforteller som kan selge både visjon og virkelighet

  • Har tro på Øygarden som destinasjon og mulighetene prosjektet representerer

Hvorfor velge oss?

Fordi dette er en sjelden mulighet.

Du får være med helt fra starten og sette ditt preg på et av regionens mest spennende hotell- og konferanseprosjekter.

Du blir med på å skrive neste kapittel i hotelleventyret på Straume.

Du får påvirke strategi, kundeportefølje og markedsposisjon.

Og når dørene åpner i 2029, vil du kunne se tilbake på noe få salgsledere får oppleve:

At du var med på å bygge markedet før produktet eksisterte.

Vi tilbyr

  • En unik rolle i utviklingen av The Coastal Conference City

  • Muligheten til å bygge opp konferansemarkedet fra grunnen av

  • Et sterkt fagmiljø og en av Norges mest solide merkevarer i ryggen

  • Stor frihet og påvirkningskraft

  • Konkurransedyktige betingelser

  • Arbeidssted ved Thon Hotel Straume

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Våre virksomhetsområder

Thon Gruppen er et av Norges største privateide konsern, eid av Thon Stiftelsen. Vi driver innen hotell, eiendom, og servering, og har rundt 3 000 årsverk.

Vi er engasjert i:

Thon Hotels: En av Norges største hotellkjeder, med over 90 hoteller i Norge, Sverige, Danmark, Belgia og Nederland.

Thon Eiendom: Norges største private eiendomsaktør med utleie og salg av bolig- og næringseiendom, samt drift av over 80 kjøpesentre i Norge og Sverige.

Resthon: Vår serveringsvirksomhet med barer og restauranter – fra gastropuber til spillkonsepter – med fokus på god mat og god stemning. Les mer

    Omsetningen i 2024 var ca. 13,9 milliarder kroner. Les mer om konsernet her: thon.no/om

    Hvorfor jobbe hos oss?
    • Et trygt og inkluderende arbeidsmiljø med fokus på bærekraft og langsiktighet
    • Gode utviklings- og karrieremuligheter, med fokus på intern rekruttering
    • Mulighet til å jobbe i et konsern med stor bredde og mange ulike roller

    Vi er opptatt av mangfold og likestilling, og oppfordrer alle kvalifiserte kandidater til å søke – uansett alder, kjønn, bakgrunn eller funksjonsevne.

    Les mer om hvordan det er å jobbe hos oss: thon.no/karriere

    Samfunnsansvar og bærekraft

    Gjennom Thon Stiftelsen og i vår daglige drift jobber vi aktivt med:

    • Deltakelse i FNs Global Compact
    • Miljøfyrtårn-sertifisering av våre hoteller
    • Reduksjon av matsvinn
    • Fokus på likestilling og mangfold
    • Støtte til forskning og allmennyttige formål
