Detta ger möjlighet till ett brett arbete inom avancerad tandvård, mjukdelskirurgi, hältutredningar, medicinska utredningar, profylaktiska behandlingar och friskvård.Vi söker dig som är intresserad av och har erfarenhet av narkosarbete. title: Product Manager (Security)
description: TL;DRWe're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own Security at Lovable, end-to-end, from conception through rollout. You'll make sure the millions of apps built on Lovable are safe, trustworthy, and secure by default, turning security from a checkbox into a genuine product differentiator.Why Lovable?Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.What we're looking for    8+ years in the software industry, with exposure to security, trust & safety, or platform integrity in a product management or engineering leadership role    Familiarity with the security challenges unique to AI-generated software, including code vulnerabilities, prompt injection, and unsafe defaults, and how to build secure-by-default experiences users don't have to think about    Technical fluency: you program or have programmed, and can engage credibly with engineers on threat models, vulnerabilities, and platform architecture    Strong product sense and systems thinking. You know how to translate security constraints into good user experiences rather than friction, and you have sharp opinions on when security should be invisible vs. unmistakable    Preferred: Prior experience working on platform security or trust & safety at scale; familiarity with enterprise security requirements and how they influence product decisionsWhat you'll do    Represent the user. Bring findings on security posture, threat models, and trust signals to the team with clarity and conviction    Run discovery end-to-end: user interviews, competitive research, data analysis, and crafting security messaging that resonates with both technical and non-technical users    Shape how security surfaces across the product, spanning AI output review, permissions, publishing safeguards, and vulnerability detection    Scope ruthlessly. Ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn't    Enable sales, support, and marketing with the context they need to speak credibly about security, especially for enterprise buyers where it's a dealbreaker    Projects you'll tackle first: Mapping the current threat surface across Lovable-generated apps and defining the biggest gaps; owning the first iteration of secure-by-default publishing safeguards; building the internal framework for how security features get scoped, prioritized, and communicated across the companyAbout your applicationPlease submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Product Manager (Identity & Access Management)
description: TL;DR: We’re looking for a Product Manager to help shape Lovable’s Identity & Access Management team and own how authentication, authorization, and identity work across the existing Lovable app ecosystem and the more than one million new apps built every week. You’ll work with a talented team of engineers and designers to build open, scalable identity primitives that serve individual builders, enterprises, application users, developers, and AI agents without compromising Lovable’s simplicity.Why Lovable?Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.What we’re looking for    Significant experience owning technically complex products, across identity, authentication, authorization, developer platforms, or infrastructure.    A track record of setting product direction in ambiguous problem spaces, aligning teams around a clear strategy, and turning that strategy into shipped products.    Strong knowledge of modern identity systems and open standards, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, passkeys, service accounts, roles, permissions, and policy-based access control.    Technical fluency. You program or have programmed, and can engage credibly with engineers on platform architecture, APIs, data models, security boundaries, and identity protocols.    Strong product sense and systems thinking. You can prioritize across authentication, authorization, and identity needs while building simple primitives that can support enormous scale and increasingly sophisticated use cases.    Exceptional communication skills and sharp judgment. You can navigate difficult tradeoffs, explain the options and consequences clearly, and help teams reach informed decisions.    A deep appreciation for the needs of personal and enterprise users, as well as both sides of the Lovable experience: the builder configuring identity and the end user interacting with a Lovable-built app.What you’ll do    Represent the user. Develop a deep understanding of identity needs across existing Lovable-built apps and the more than one million new apps created every week.    Own the product strategy and roadmap for authentication, authorization, and identity, making deliberate tradeoffs between immediate user needs and durable platform foundations.    Define standards-based primitives for users, organizations, agents, roles, permissions, policies, sessions, and delegated access that can scale across a vast and varied application ecosystem.    Shape a smooth identity experience for both builders configuring their apps and the people using those apps.    Partner closely with engineering to balance the needs of individual builders and enterprise organizations, preserving Lovable’s simplicity while building a foundation that can scale.    Define how AI agents and other non-human identities authenticate, receive authority, act on behalf of users, and remain understandable and controllable.    Own identity and access needs for programmatic use of Lovable across API, CLI, SDK, and MCP surfaces.    Keep it simple. Ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn’t.Projects you’ll tackle first: Partner with engineering to shape and deliver a multi-tenant identity service built on open standards that supports authentication and authorization across millions of applications and provides a durable foundation for Lovable.About your applicationPlease submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Planner & Scheduler
description: Studies show that women and underrepresented groups often hesitate to apply unless they meet every requirement. At Stegra, we’re building an impact-driven, sustainable company - and we need a diverse, inclusive team to make it happen.If you share our passion but don’t meet every qualification, we encourage you to apply anyway. You might be the perfect fit for this role, or another as we grow.At Stegra, we’re not just building a plant, we’re proving that sustainable industry is possible. And to do that, we need people like you.Join a team where safety comes first. Where we support each other, learn as we go, and make space for everyone to grow and contribute. This is your chance to be part of something big - while being closer to nature and leading a balanced, purposeful life.Employment: Temporary, 12-24 monthsLocation: BodenWhat you’ll doRight now, we are looking for a Planner & Scheduler for our Planning & Scheduling team. In this role you will sit within our Project Delivery function and support planning and scheduling activities for an assigned project area.As Planner & Scheduler, you will work closely with Construction, Engineering, Commissioning, Project Controls, EPCM partners, and contractors to maintain realistic and integrated schedules. You will help track progress, identify constraints and schedule risks, and provide reliable planning information to support project execution and decision-making.Specific to this role, the day-to-day tasks will include the following but as we are a growing company with very little silos between teams, other tasks might be included as well.    Develop, update, and maintain project schedules in line with project planning standards    Support the maintenance and integration of the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS) for your assigned area    Review EPCM and contractor schedules and identify inconsistencies, missing logic, constraints, and potential impacts    Integrate schedule information from contractors, EPCM partners, and internal stakeholders    Monitor actual progress against planned activities and support schedule updates and forecasting    Analyze schedules to identify delays, trends, risks, constraints, and opportunities    Support mitigation and recovery planning when schedule challenges arise    Participate in site reviews, coordination meetings, planning workshops, and weekly and monthly reportingWhat you’ll bringYou’re curious and believe that real progress happens when we work together. You’re not afraid to challenge old ways of thinking and you treat others with respect while doing it. At Stegra, we value people who take initiative, build trust, and help create a workplace where everyone can do their best.Specific to this role, we would like to see that you can tick off a fair amount of the boxes below    3+ years of relevant experience in project planning and scheduling or similar roles, preferably within industrial, construction, infrastructure, or EPCM projects    Relevant degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, Project Controls, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience    Good understanding of project planning and scheduling methodologies    Experience developing, updating, and analyzing project schedules    Understanding of Integrated Master Schedules (IMS), schedule integration, progress measurement, and forecasting    Ability to review contractor and EPCM schedules and identify constraints, risks, and inconsistencies    Experience using relevant planning and scheduling tools    Strong analytical, organizational, and communication skills, with fluency in EnglishBenefits at Stegra At Stegra, you’ll join a company where your work has real impact on the climate, the industry, and future generations. We’re building a culture rooted in safety, trust, and inclusion, where people feel supported to grow and thrive.You’ll receive fair, competitive compensation aligned with collective agreements, along with benefits like up to 30 days of paid vacation, occupational pension, parental benefits, and insurance. If you need support with relocation or immigration, our relocation department will help guide you through the process, whether it’s permits, housing or other practical matters. You can also enjoy perks like subsidized gym memberships and bike leases, plus the everyday benefits of life closer to nature.Read more about Benefits at Stegra here.This is StegraStegra is on a mission to change the global steel industry by producing green hydrogen, iron, and steel - with the goal of eliminating CO₂ emissions. Instead of coal, we use green hydrogen and fossil-free electricity, meaning our primary emissions will be water and heat.By 2030, our ambition is to produce 5 million tonnes of green steel annually in our fully integrated, digitized, and sustainable plant in Boden, Northern Sweden - currently under construction. But this is just the beginning. Our expertise in green hydrogen will enable us to decarbonize industries beyond steel, paving the way for a cleaner future.Our Boden SiteOur Boden site is located just west of Boden City, right in the heart of a growing green industrial hub in Northern Sweden. It’s where we’re building one of the world’s most modern, sustainable steel plants—designed with safety, efficiency, and people in mind. With just a 10-minute commute from town, you'll be close to both cutting-edge technology and the everyday convenience of living near nature, schools, and community life.Boden Video

title: People Business Partner

Du blir en del av vårt People-team och ingår också i ett större sammanhang med People Business Partners i andra E.ON-bolag och centrala specialistfunktioner. Din rollSom People Business Partner är du en nära partner till chefer och lokala ledningsgrupper och omsätter verksamhetens behov i konkreta HR-insatser. Rollen förenar strategiskt och taktiskt arbete med chefsstöd i vardagen.Du vägleder i frågor som rör organisationsutveckling, förändring, bemanning och kompetensförsörjning. Du stöttar också chefer i arbetsrätt, rehabilitering och komplexa personalärenden samt förbereder och genomför facklig samverkan och MBL-förhandlingar. Tillsammans med chefer och HSE arbetar du för en trygg och hälsosam arbetsmiljö, med fokus på bland annat organisatorisk och social arbetsmiljö och ett hållbart arbetsliv.Tillsammans utvecklar vi arbetssätt och beteenden som stödjer verksamhetens förflyttning. Här får du bidra med perspektiv på hur digitalisering och AI kan förenkla och utveckla People-arbetet.Du utgår från Malmö, Eftersom du stöttar verksamheter i Norrköping, Stockholm och Örebro med chefer på flera orter är resor en naturlig och återkommande del av uppdraget. Dina erfarenheterVi söker dig som har en relevant akademisk utbildning inom HR, beteendevetenskap eller motsvarande och bred erfarenhet av kvalificerat HR-arbete nära chefer och ledningsgrupper. Du har god kunskap om svensk arbetsrätt, kollektivavtal och facklig samverkan samt erfarenhet av rehabilitering och arbetsmiljöfrågor.Du är van vid att stödja förändring och att tillsammans med chefer omsätta verksamhetens behov i prioriteringar och aktiviteter. Du använder gärna HR-data som underlag och känner dig bekväm med digitala HR-system. Du kommunicerar tydligt på svenska och engelska och anpassar ditt stöd efter olika människor och situationer.Du förenar empati och lyhördhet med tydlighet och integritet. Med blicken på helheten tar du självständigt ansvar, bygger förtroende och vågar lyfta svåra frågor. För dig är det naturligt att dela kunskap, stötta andra och känna stolthet över det vi åstadkommer tillsammans. Hur är det hos oss?Hos oss möter du ett hjälpsamt team där vi delar kunskap och stöttar varandra. Du får utrymme att forma ditt arbete och bidra med dina perspektiv, med kollegor nära till hands som bollplank. Din chef Josefina har ett inkluderande och utvecklingsorienterat ledarskap som bygger på tillit, nyfikenhet och tydlig riktning. Hon tror på att de bästa resultaten skapas tillsammans och uppmuntrar till att utforska nya arbetssätt och utvecklas i uppdraget.På E.ON arbetar vi aktivt med inkludering - det är avgörande för att driva energiomställningen framåt. Vi vill att just du ska känna dig välkommen! Vi strävar efter att skapa en trygg arbetsmiljö med meningsfulla arbetsuppgifter och goda möjligheter till utveckling. Vi fortsätter hela tiden att utmana oss själva för att skapa en välkomnande arbetsplats, där vi hoppas att du kommer att trivas.Vi arbetar för ett mer hållbart energisamhälle, men det är minst lika viktigt att våra medarbetare har förutsättningar att värna om sin personliga hållbarhet. Vi erbjuder därför bra förmåner för att du ska må bra och ha god balans mellan arbete och fritid. Några av dessa är arbetstidsförkortning som är högre än branschens standard, hälsoförsäkring, fri sjukvård och mer därtill!Varmt välkommen att söka och var med oss på vägen mot ett mer hållbart samhälle! Sista ansökningsdag är 13 november kl 10.00.Då vi arbetar med samhällsviktig verksamhet är anställningen säkerhetsklassad, vilket innebär att en säkerhetsprövning kommer att genomföras innan anställning.För frågor om tjänsten, vänligen kontakta rekryterande chef: Josefina Cederberg Wallin, josefina.cederberg-wallin@eon.se För fackliga frågor, vänligen kontakta:Mats Ekblom, +46 705 259188Akademikerna, Akademikerna@eon.seMattias Andolfsson, Ledarna, mattias.andolfsson@eon.seMats Lundberg, SEKO +46 730 499778

title: Product Manager (Identity & Access Management)
description: TL;DR: We’re looking for a Product Manager to help shape Lovable’s Identity & Access Management team and own how authentication, authorization, and identity work across the existing Lovable app ecosystem and the more than one million new apps built every week. You’ll work with a talented team of engineers and designers to build open, scalable identity primitives that serve individual builders, enterprises, application users, developers, and AI agents without compromising Lovable’s simplicity.Why Lovable?Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.What we’re looking for    Significant experience owning technically complex products, across identity, authentication, authorization, developer platforms, or infrastructure.    A track record of setting product direction in ambiguous problem spaces, aligning teams around a clear strategy, and turning that strategy into shipped products.    Strong knowledge of modern identity systems and open standards, including OAuth, OpenID Connect, SAML, SCIM, passkeys, service accounts, roles, permissions, and policy-based access control.    Technical fluency. You program or have programmed, and can engage credibly with engineers on platform architecture, APIs, data models, security boundaries, and identity protocols.    Strong product sense and systems thinking. You can prioritize across authentication, authorization, and identity needs while building simple primitives that can support enormous scale and increasingly sophisticated use cases.    Exceptional communication skills and sharp judgment. You can navigate difficult tradeoffs, explain the options and consequences clearly, and help teams reach informed decisions.    A deep appreciation for the needs of personal and enterprise users, as well as both sides of the Lovable experience: the builder configuring identity and the end user interacting with a Lovable-built app.What you’ll do    Represent the user. Develop a deep understanding of identity needs across existing Lovable-built apps and the more than one million new apps created every week.    Own the product strategy and roadmap for authentication, authorization, and identity, making deliberate tradeoffs between immediate user needs and durable platform foundations.    Define standards-based primitives for users, organizations, agents, roles, permissions, policies, sessions, and delegated access that can scale across a vast and varied application ecosystem.    Shape a smooth identity experience for both builders configuring their apps and the people using those apps.    Partner closely with engineering to balance the needs of individual builders and enterprise organizations, preserving Lovable’s simplicity while building a foundation that can scale.    Define how AI agents and other non-human identities authenticate, receive authority, act on behalf of users, and remain understandable and controllable.    Own identity and access needs for programmatic use of Lovable across API, CLI, SDK, and MCP surfaces.    Keep it simple. Ship the right slice of functionality, validate what works through user feedback and metrics, and cut what doesn’t.Projects you’ll tackle first: Partner with engineering to shape and deliver a multi-tenant identity service built on open standards that supports authentication and authorization across millions of applications and provides a durable foundation for Lovable.About your applicationPlease submit your application in English. It's our company language, so you'll be speaking lots of it if you join. We treat all candidates equally - if you're interested, please apply through our careers portal.

title: Operations Analysis Engineer

If you are passionate about data-driven decision-making, operational excellence, and continuous improvement, this opportunity is for you!WHO ARE WE?We work every day to electrify the world for a greener future. It is one of the key components ensuring the optimal performance of batteries.Founded in 2003 in Shenzhen, China, Senior Material has been driven by innovation since the very beginning.Since 2021, we have established our European headquarters in Eskilstuna, Sweden. title: Modelling and Simulation PK/PD Expert
description: Are you a passionate individual with expertise in mathematical modelling and pharmacokinetics/pharmacodynamics (PK/PD)? Do you want to apply quantitative approaches to help shape the development of future treatments for cardiovascular, renal and metabolic diseases?If so, we invite you to join our Modelling & Simulation team within the Early Cardiovascular, Renal and Metabolism (CVRM) therapeutic area at AstraZeneca. This position is based at our dynamic R&D site in Gothenburg, Sweden.  Accountabilities: As a Modelling and Simulation PK/PD expert, you will play a key role in shaping project strategies and driving critical decisions across our drug discovery portfolio. You will actively contribute to drug project teams, providing quantitative insights to inform target and molecule selection, dosing strategies, and translational development decisions.You will design and oversee the execution of complex studies in preclinical disease models, applying advanced mathematical modelling approaches to deliver impactful PK/PD and translational insights. Your expertise will enable you to synthesize data from multiple sources, predict human pharmacokinetics and pharmacodynamics, and influence the definition of efficacious exposure and dosing regimens. In this role, you will present and defend your quantitative assessments and recommendations to internal governance and senior stakeholders, shaping critical decisions at the highest levels. You will also provide scientific leadership by initiating and leading strategic DMPK and PK/PD innovation projects, fostering collaboration across disciplines, and representing AstraZeneca's modelling expertise both internally and within the broader scientific community.  Essential Skills/Experience:     PhD in pharmacokinetics, pharmacology, mathematics, or related field, with a focus on model-based PK/PD approaches.    Industry or academic experience in exposure-response modelling such as PK/PD, NLME, PBPK and/or QSP, with hands-on experience using relevant modelling and programming tools (e.g., Phoenix, R, MATLAB, Python, Monolix, NONMEM)     Demonstrated ability to integrate complex data, apply quantitative reasoning, and translate modelling results into recommendations that inform project decisions    Demonstrated scientific leadership and a strong track record of scientific contributions in a relevant area    Experience applying AI and machine learning to quantitative research workflows, for example in data curation, PK/PD modelling or translational modelling    Excellent communication and influencing skills, with the ability to present complex quantitative results clearly to cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders Desirable Skills/Experience:     Experience applying PK/PD modelling in a preclinical or translational setting    Experience developing quantitative modelling strategies across multiple therapeutic modalities such as small molecules, oligonucleotides, peptides, proteins, antibodies or cell and gene therapies    Experience in PBPK modelling using platforms such as Simcyp or PK-Sim  At AstraZeneca, we are driven by results and use our unique blend of science and commercial knowledge to spot opportunities and drive outcomes. We are part of an expansive healthcare ecosystem that connects key players across the entire patient journey. Our patient-first approach informs every decision we make. We are committed to your development and believe that your best is better here. Join us and be part of a global team of curious, collaborative colleagues.Ready to make your mark? Apply now and be a part of our journey to redefine the future of healthcare! We welcome your application by November 17, 2026.

title: Business Development Manager
description: Kentix is on a mission to establish KentixONE as a leading operating system for physical IT security. Our focus is mission-critical IT environments, from individual racks and distributed IT rooms to modular data centers and white-space environments.As part of ASSA ABLOY, we are now expanding into the Swedish market.We are looking for an entrepreneurial Business Development Manager who wants to do more than sell products. You'll develop and drive our go-to-market strategy for Sweden. As the face of Kentix in the Swedish market, you'll build relationships with end customers and partners, create new business opportunities and help establish Kentix as a recognized provider of physical IT security solutions.What you'll work on    Drive the commercial growth of Kentix in Sweden, taking ownership of market development and helping establish Kentix as a trusted partner for physical IT security.    Identify, engage and win new business opportunities with end customers operating mission-critical IT environments, including data centers, critical infrastructure and enterprise IT organizations.    Expand the Kentix ecosystem by collaborating with partners, consultants, system integrators and other key stakeholders across the Swedish market.    Act as the local Kentix expert and pre-sales consultant, supporting ASSA ABLOY sales teams with customer opportunities, solution specifications and the successful positioning of KentixONE.What will help you succeed    Experience in Business Development, solution sales or market development within data centers, IT infrastructure, critical infrastructure, physical security, networking, power infrastructure or related technology sectors.    An established network within the Swedish market and the ability to leverage relationships to create commercial opportunities.    Experience selling complex technical solutions to enterprise customers through direct and partner-led channels.    Strong relationship-building skills and the ability to engage confidently with both technical and commercial stakeholders.    Fluent Swedish and English communication skills and willingness to travel across Sweden to meet customers and partners.Why KentixKentix combines physical security, access control and infrastructure monitoring in one integrated platform designed for mission-critical IT environments. As we expand in Sweden, you'll join at a pivotal stage of our growth journey. This is an opportunity to combine the agility of a growing business with the strength of ASSA ABLOY while helping customers protect mission-critical IT environments.    Meaningful Impact – Help organizations protect critical IT infrastructure and improve operational resilience in environments where reliability is essential.    Innovative Technology – Represent KentixONE, an integrated platform that brings together physical security, access control and monitoring capabilities in a single solution.    Entrepreneurial Freedom – Take ownership of a developing market and play a direct role in shaping our growth in Sweden.    International Collaboration – Work alongside experienced Business Development colleagues across Europe while benefiting from the strength and stability of ASSA ABLOY.    Flexible Working – Work where you're closest to customers, with the flexibility and autonomy needed to succeed in a market-facing role. Ready to build a market rather than inherit one?If you're excited by the opportunity to build a market, work with innovative technology and make a direct impact on Kentix's success in Sweden, we'd like to hear from you.Apply today and help us create a safer and more open world.We review applications continuously and will be moving forward with suitable candidates throughout the process. Just set up your profile and apply here. To make sure your personal data is safe, we don't review applications sent by email or post. If you have any questions about the role or the process, please contact Léa Rein, Senior Talent Acquisition Business Partner at lea.rein@assaabloy.comDepending on the risk profile for the role, a background screening may need to be performed. Final candidates may therefore be subject to a background screening. The performance of a background check is subject to consent and based on our Applicant Privacy Notice.We are the ASSA ABLOY GroupOur people have made us the global leader in access solutions. In return, we open doors for them wherever they go. With nearly 63,000 colleagues in more than 70 different countries, we help billions of people experience a more open world. Our innovations make all sorts of spaces – physical and virtual – safer, more secure, and easier to access. As an employer, we value results – not titles, or backgrounds. We empower our people to build their career around their aspirations and our ambitions – supporting them with regular feedback, training, and development opportunities. Our colleagues think broadly about where they can make the most impact, and we encourage them to grow their role locally, regionally, or even internationally.As we welcome new people on board, it’s important to us to have diverse, inclusive teams, and we value different perspectives and experiences.

title: Senior Automation  Engineer -SCADA
description: Job Title: Senior Automation Engineer SCADAAbout the Role: We are seeking a highly analytical and experienced Senior Automation Engineer SCADA to ensure the efficient, reliable, and secure operation of our SCADA networks and Substation Automation Systems (SAS). The ideal candidate will be a technical expert capable of leading projects from bay to entire substation SAS/SCADA design and commissioning.Key Responsibilities & Core Requirements:    HVAC Substation Automation: Core Knowledge and Hands-on experience in HVAC Substation Automation.    System & Network Mastery: Extensive SCADA, RTU, PLC, Networking, and Protocol expertise. Familiarity with multi-vendor systems (such as ABB RTU, Schneider PACiS, or MicroSCADA) and PLC programming is highly valued.    Design & Commissioning: Hands-on experience in design and commissioning of HVAC Substations (specifically 66/132kV). This must include IED Communication configuration, signal testing, SCADA Configuration, Data concentrator configuration, along with Protocol conversion knowledge and hands-on experience.    Process & Risk Management: Able to follow the process, identify gaps and risks, and propose solution recommendations to ensure the operational integrity of our SAS/SCADA systems remains optimal.    Protocol Proficiency: Competence in configuring and troubleshooting standard industry protocols, including IEC61850, IEC60870-5-101, IEC60870-5-104, DNP3, and Modbus.    Testing & Execution: Preparation of signal lists, commissioning reports, and active participation in Factory Acceptance Testing (FAT) and Site Acceptance Testing (SAT).    Cybersecurity & Networking: Enforcement of cybersecurity adherence, user profile management on SAS systems, and configuration of Ethernet switches, VLANs, and network redundancy.    Why Join Us? As a Senior Automation Engineer, you will provide expert advice on SAS/SCADA best trends, taking on a crucial role in project scoping, supervision, and the management of major SCADA project works. If you have a proven track record of maintaining conducive operational environments and delivering high-quality automation engineering solutions, we encourage you to apply.

title: Head of Digital – Retail to Lindex, Gothenburg
description: The opportunityThis is a broad digital leadership role with responsibility for the systems and capabilities that support Lindex entire retail network. You have the opportunity to influence both operational reliability and the future development of the retail area.The role combines a focused application portfolio with complex operational dependencies. A new point-of-sale system has recently been introduced and offers further development potential, while the continued establishment of new stores places clear demands on scalable processes and dependable infrastructure. You work closely with colleagues across Digital, Technology, Facilities, Properties and the wider business to turn retail priorities into sustainable digital solutions. You translate Lindex’s overall strategy into a clear digital direction, setting priorities and driving the development of digital solutions, data, AI and technology to support sustainable growth, profitability and long-term business success.Working in close partnership with business and functional leaders, you ensure that digital priorities are aligned with business objectives and translated into tangible results. You lead digital development across the retail network, balancing reliable day-to-day operations with continuous improvement and future-focused innovation. By strengthening digital capabilities and embedding new technologies into retail operations, you enhance the employee and customer experience while driving efficiency and operational performance.You also lead competence development in new digital capabilities and ways of working, strengthening Lindex digital maturity and ability to embrace future opportunities. title: Produktspecialist - Underjordsutrustning
description: Company description:Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.Job description:Produktspecialist - Underjordsutrustning Följ med oss när vi accelererar transformationen! Som Produktspecialist – Underjordsutrustning hos Epiroc får du en nyckelroll i att stötta våra kunder och interna serviceteam med djup teknisk kompetens inom underjordsutrustning. Du är en senior teknisk rådgivare som bidrar till säkra, effektiva och hållbara lösningar — och gör verklig skillnad där det händer. Bli en del av vårt team Du blir en del av Epirocs serviceverksamhet, där säkerhet, samarbete och teknisk spetskompetens står i centrum. Vi arbetar nära våra kunder och stöttar varandra i vardagen, med målet att alltid leverera högsta kvalitet och bygga långsiktiga relationer. Hos oss är du en viktig representant för Epirocs varumärke och våra värderingar: Innovation, Samarbete och Engagemang. Ditt uppdrag I rollen som Produktspecialist arbetar du både strategiskt och operativt. Du är en central kompetensresurs som kombinerar tekniskt arbete i fält med rådgivning, utbildning och problemlösning. Ditt uppdrag innebär bland annat att: •    Agera senior teknisk rådgivare gentemot kunder och interna servicetekniker•    Utföra service, reparationer, felsökning och uppstarter av underjordsutrustning•    Genomföra praktiska utbildningar för nyanställda och kunder•    Säkerställa att arbete utförs säkert genom riskanalyser och efterlevnad av Epirocs regelverk•    Ha en löpande och proaktiv kunddialog genom hela arbetsprocessen•    Bidra till utveckling av arbetssätt, processer och verksamhet•    Dokumentera arbeten, rapportera tid och material samt vid behov bistå med prisestimat Du arbetar nära både kunder och kollegor och har en viktig roll i att skapa förtroende och långsiktigt kundvärde. Din profilDu är en trygg, lösningsorienterad och engagerad person som trivs i en roll där du får ta ansvar och dela med dig av din kunskap. Säkerhet är en självklar del av ditt arbetssätt, och du har lätt för att samarbeta och kommunicera tydligt. Vi ser gärna att du har: •    Stark teknisk kompetens och erfarenhet av service och felsökning av underjords utrustning•    Förmåga att arbeta självständigt och samtidigt ge stöd och rådgivning i mer komplexa ärenden•    Ett strukturerat och kundfokuserat arbetssätt med god kommunikationsförmåga•    God förståelse i svenska och engelska Erfarenhet av utbildning, teknisk support eller arbete i kundnära miljö är meriterande. Livet på Epiroc När du blir en del av Epiroc kan du förvänta dig en atmosfär av kreativitet, innovation och mångfald. Du kommer att vara en del av en grupp skickliga och hjälpsamma kollegor som alla lever efter våra kärnvärden: samarbete, engagemang och innovation. Vi arbetar i en global miljö med över 113 nationaliteter. Förutom att vi har en kultur som kännetecknas av utveckling i kombination med en bra balans mellan arbete och fritid, finns det några saker som gör oss lite extra stolta över att arbeta på Epiroc: •    Globala karriärmöjligheter.•    Epiroc University, för din egen kompetensutveckling.•    Samhällsengagemang.•    Förmånspaket, som bland annat inkluderar flexibel arbetstid och bonus Placering och resorDenna tjänst är placerad i Slagsta. Resor förekommer främst i Stockholmsområdet, men det kan även förekomma resor till andra orter. Ansökan och kontaktinformationVi uppmuntrar dig att skicka in din ansökan via vår karriärsida så snart som möjligt, men senast den 29 november 2026: Ansökningar granskas löpande och tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdatum. Vi är engagerade i en grundlig rekryteringsprocess som inkluderar intervjuer, referenstagning och tester. För att säkerställa en trygg arbetsmiljö genomför vi identitetskontroller och drog- och alkoholtester. Vår process är utformad för att vara rättvis och inkluderande; du kan förvänta dig transparent kommunikation och en balanserad utvärdering av dina färdigheter och erfarenheter. Vänligen observera att vi på grund av rådande regelverk inte kan hantera ansökningar som skickas in via e-post.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Payments
description: We're looking for a Senior Software Engineer to join our Payments team in Stockholm. You'll help set and implement this technical direction.We’re a small and collaborative team that owns services end to end, from domain model to Terraform, on-call included. You'll work closely with Product, Finance, and the web teams whose checkout journeys sit on our APIs. AI is part of our daily toolchain, which puts more weight on judgement: we read as much code as we write.Your key responsibilities include    Own payment and subscription services end to end: design, build, deploy and monitor them.        Build the next generation of our purchase platform in Go, and move live subscriptions onto it safely.        Build and maintain our payment provider integrations, including the compliance-heavy parts like 3DS and SCA.        Work in the customer-facing purchase flow in our web codebase (TypeScript) when needed.Requirements    Several years building and running backend services in production, ideally in a space where correctness mattered more than shipping speed.        Strong in Go or Python, and happy to get productive in the other. Our services are built in both.        Good in SQL and relational data modelling. We use Postgres.        Cloud experience, preferably Google Cloud, and comfortable owning your own infrastructure (Kubernetes, Helm, Terraform).        Enough TypeScript and React to make changes in a shared frontend codebase, or a real interest in picking it up.        Experience with payments, or a clear interest in it: subscriptions, billing, provider integrations, reconciliation, etc.It would also be music to our ears if you have    Migrated a billing or payment platform with live customers on it.        Worked with PSPs, card networks, 3DS and SCA, or inside PCI scope.        Experience building event-driven services using Pub/Sub or a comparable messaging system.        Practical experience applying AI coding agents in production, and sound judgement about when to rely on them.

title: Inventory Planner
description: Company DescriptionIn Supply Chain Operations, we lead, plan and execute the supply of IKEA products between suppliers and retailers. We work across the IKEA value chain to make sure products reach stores and retail partners in a simple, efficient and responsible way. Our shared goals are clear: availability, affordability and sustainability. Together, we help make IKEA products available for the many people. Within SCO, Category Area Logistics Services secures and develops the logistics services that make the goods flow work in practice. We work with distribution, mid-receiver units and food logistics services. Together with our logistics service providers, we secure the right capacity, cost, service, quality, safety and sustainability. Category Food Logistics Services is part of CALS and focuses on securing logistics solutions for IKEA Food, including warehousing, cold-chain transportation and goods flow to stores. We work with temperature-controlled flows and everyday follow-up to support availability, food safety, freshness, cost efficiency and sustainability across markets. IKEA Food is an important part of the total IKEA experience. It helps us welcome people, bring Swedish food traditions to life, support everyday moments in our stores, and make good food available to the many people. Behind every meal, snack and food product, there is a goods flow that needs to be safe, fresh, reliable and cost-conscious. In Category Food Logistics Services, we commit to make that happen. About the role  We are now looking for an Inventory Planner who wants to be part of the IKEA Food goods flow, where planning accuracy supports availability, freshness, food safety and a stronger customer experience. In this role, daily planning and execution come together so food products can move safely, reliably and efficiently from supplier to distribution centre and onwards into the IKEA Food experience. The role works closely with Category, suppliers, service providers, distribution centres and internal planning teams. You will use signals from orders, stock, forecasts, lead times and distribution to take clear inventory actions, supporting the Food transformation ambition to simplify execution, reduce handovers and focus planning where it creates business value. In this role you will:     Own supplier-to-DC and/or DC-DC inbound availability for assigned products, DCs and markets.     Maintain accurate inventory and inbound flow execution, including orders, ERP corrections and physical-flow corrections.     Act on daily inventory corrections, inbound order handling, flow bookings and deviations within agreed parameters.     Balance availability, food safety, freshness, cost, sustainability and lead-time adherence when planning and following up the inbound flow.     Secure supplier and logistics-service-provider execution through confirmations, holiday planning, inbound coordination and invoice follow-up.     Manage deviations related to quality, blocked goods, shelf life, shortages and inventory accuracy with timely action and escalation.     Improve ways of working together with suppliers, service providers, DC/LSP operations and internal stakeholders. We are looking for someone who:     Has experience from supply-chain operations, inventory-, supply planning, inbound logistics or DC flow.     Works confidently in ERP e.g. Infor tools, order-management and planning systems.     Uses operational KPIs, inventory data and deviation follow-up to make clear decisions, including using excel and Power Bi.     Understands availability at lowest cost, freshness, quality and inventory-accuracy risks, and knows when to act or escalate.     Communicates well across suppliers, logistics service providers and internal teams.     Takes pride in accuracy, structure and keeping the inbound goods flow reliable every day. Reliable availability depends on many small inventory and inbound flow decisions done right, every day. As Inventory Planner, you help secure the right products in the right place at the right time, with good freshness, compliance, service and cost-conscious flow. You turn supplier, inventory and distribution signals into action so stores and partners can rely on stable availability, and IKEA Food can be enjoyed with trust, quality and care across markets. As part of your application, we ask you to rank the Food roles you apply for in order of preference. This helps us better understand your aspirations and supports a fair and efficient matching process across opportunities.For questions about the role, please contact Business Development Managers Irina Kärnsund via, irina.karnsund@inter.ikea.comWe look forward to receiving your application by the 17th of November, 2026.If you have any questions regarding the recruitment process contact People & Culture Specialists Samuel Karlsson via samuel.karlsson@inter.ikea.com We always recruit based on values, competence, potential and diversity. Once competence requirements are met, we will first consider impacted co-workers at Inter IKEA Group.

With a proven track record of successful partnerships with top companies, we have rapidly grown our presence in the USA, Europe, and Sweden as a dependable and trusted resource within the IT industry.Job OverviewRole SummaryOur client is seeking an operational and solution-oriented Project Manager to support the continued development and improvement of its digital sales channels. The assignment focuses on coordinating ongoing e-commerce development, translating business needs into actionable initiatives, and ensuring that enhancements and new functionality are implemented and followed up effectively.This is a hands-on role with extensive collaboration across business stakeholders, internal development teams, and external partners. The Project Manager will coordinate several parallel activities, address delivery challenges, and maintain momentum across the e-commerce development portfolio.Key Responsibilities    Coordinate and drive ongoing e-commerce development initiatives and improvements.    Gather requests, requirements, and operational needs from business stakeholders.    Translate identified needs into concrete, structured, and actionable activities.    Coordinate delivery across the business, internal development teams, and external partners.    Ensure that improvements and new functionality are implemented, monitored, and followed up.    Manage multiple concurrent activities and resolve issues that could affect delivery progress.    Maintain clear ownership, coordination, and forward momentum throughout the development process.Technical Stack & Requirements    Practical experience coordinating digital development or e-commerce initiatives.    Competence in project management, requirements gathering, requirements analysis, and delivery coordination.    Ability to work effectively with internal software development teams and external delivery partners.    No specific programming languages, platforms, frameworks, or project management tools are stated in the assignment description.Qualifications & ExperienceThe assignment is suited to a mid-level Project Manager with experience in e-commerce, digital sales channels, or comparable digital development environments. The successful consultant should be comfortable working close to business operations, structuring stakeholder needs, coordinating multiple parallel initiatives, and following delivery from initial request through implementation and evaluation. The role requires a practical, delivery-focused approach and the ability to resolve problems as they arise.

title: Quality Laboratory Coordinator
description: BAT is evolving at pace into a global multi-category business. Our purpose is to create A Better Tomorrow™ by Building a Smokeless World.To achieve our ambition, we are looking for colleagues who are ready to join us on this journey! Tomorrow can’t wait, let’s shape it together!British American Tobacco Sweden has an exciting opportunity for a Quality Laboratory Coordinator in Malmö.The Quality Laboratory Coordinator leads and oversees the day-to-day operations of the factory Quality Laboratory, ensuring accurate, reliable, and timely testing of raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products in compliance with BAT Quality standards, legal requirements, and regulatory expectations.As the laboratory's technical lead, the role drives excellence through robust analytical practices, equipment reliability, data integrity, and capability development. The Quality Laboratory Coordinator supports factory decision-making through accurate quality data, ensures laboratory compliance, and drives continuous improvement across laboratory operations and performance.Your key responsibilities will include:    Lead, coach, and develop a team of 6-8 laboratory professionals, ensuring strong technical capability, engagement, and performance.    Manage day-to-day laboratory operations to ensure timely testing and release of raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products.    Ensure the accuracy, reliability, integrity, and timely delivery of all laboratory testing results.    Maintain compliance with BAT Quality standards, GMP, HACCP, local regulatory requirements, and applicable quality management systems.    Own and maintain laboratory systems, including SOPs, test methods, equipment calibration, validation activities, and documentation control.    Ensure data integrity, traceability, and proper documentation of all laboratory activities, testing records, and quality results.    Lead investigations into quality issues, OOS (Out of Specification) results, and laboratory deviations, implementing effective RCA and CAPA actions.    Support factory performance through quality data analysis, reporting, NCP coordination, New Product Introduction (NPI) activities, and IWS Quality Pillar initiatives.    Comply and implement activities in accordance with the rules of laws and regulations relating to environmental protection, safety at work and fire protection, and internal EHS or Sustainability standards and procedures. What are we looking for?    2-4+ years of experience in Quality Control laboratory operations within a manufacturing environment.    Previous experience leading teams and coordinating laboratory workloads in a fast-paced operational setting.    Experience managing OOS investigations, quality deviations, audit preparation, and regulatory inspections.    Proven experience in laboratory method validation, equipment qualification, calibration programs, and quality system management.    Strong knowledge of analytical testing techniques, including physical, chemical, and/or microbiological analysis.    Solid understanding of GMP, HACCP, ISO standards, laboratory compliance requirements, and data integrity principles.    Proficiency in Root Cause Analysis (RCA), CAPA management, structured problem-solving methodologies, sampling plans, and statistical quality tools.    Technical qualification or degree in a scientific or technical discipline, with GMP, HACCP, or Laboratory Quality certification required; ISO 17025 and Lean Six Sigma Green Belt knowledge or certification preferred.What we offer you?    We offer a market leading annual performance bonus (subject to eligibility)    Our range of benefits varies by country and includes diverse health plans, initiatives for work-life balance, transportation support, and a flexible holiday plan with additional incentives    Your journey with us isn't limited by boundaries; it's propelled by your aspirations. Join us at BAT and become a part of an environment that thrives on internal advancement, where your career progression isn't just a statement – it's a reality we're eager to build together. Seize the opportunity and own your development; your next chapter starts here.    You'll have access to online learning platforms and personalized growth programs to nurture your leadership skills    We prioritise continuous improvement within a transformative environment, preparing for ongoing changesWHY JOIN BAT?In BAT Sweden we strive to create a smokeless reality on a day-to-day basis. If you wonder how we are getting there, please take a look at the OMNI report – a comprehensive study done to analyse the current market trends in tobacco harm reduction.We're one of the few companies named as a Global Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute – certified in offering excellent employee conditions.Collaboration, inclusion and partnership underpin everything we do here at BAT. We are looking forward to enabling every individual to thrive, regardless of gender, sexual orientation, marital or civil partnership status, gender reassignment, race, religion or belief, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, disability, age, skills, experience, education, socio-economic and professional background, veteran status, perspectives and thinking styles. We know that embracing talent from all backgrounds is what makes us stronger and best prepared to meet our business goals.We see the career breaks as opportunities, not obstacles. Through The Global Returners program, we support professionals looking to restart their careers after an extended absence from the workforce (e.g. time out caring for family, parental leave, national service, sabbatical and/or starting an own venture).Come bring your difference and see what is possible for you at BAT. Learn more about our culture and our award winning employee experience here.If you require any reasonable adjustments or accommodations to help you perform at your best during the recruitment process, you are encouraged to notify us. We are fully committed to support you by making appropriate arrangements for you to demonstrate your full potential.

title: Product Manager MEKO Denmark  – Heavy Commercial Vehicles
description: ArbetsbeskrivningDo you have a strong background in heavy commercial vehicles, spare parts or technical aftermarket operations? Are you interested in developing your career within product management while working in an international organization?This could be an opportunity to take the next step.MEKO is looking for a Product Manager to support the continued expansion of its Commercial Vehicle Division under its FTZ brand in Denmark.You will contribute to the development of product groups within trucks, trailers and buses, combining your technical industry knowledge with practical product management and commercial coordination.We welcome candidates from both Denmark and Southern Sweden. Previous experience as a Product Manager is valuable but not essential. What matters most is your understanding of commercial vehicles and the motivation to develop within a growing business.Your responsibilitiesAs Product Manager, you will be part of MEKO's Commercial Vehicle Division and work closely with the Danish FTZ Truck & Trailer organization.You will support the development of several product groups within Heavy Commercial Vehicles, helping ensure the right assortment, pricing and product information are available to meet customer needs and commercial objectives.Your responsibilities will include:•    Identifying and supporting new product launches and assortment development initiatives.•    Preparing sourcing requirements and request-for-quotation material, as well as evaluating products together with colleagues in other MEKO markets.•    Coordinating product introductions, replacements and phase-outs.•    Managing product data and maintaining information in catalogues and PIM systems.•    Monitoring competitor offerings and contributing to pricing and assortment decisions.•    Following up on product performance, price levels, returns, obsolescence and opportunities for assortment improvements.•    Providing technical product knowledge and supporting the sales organization in product-related matters.•    Working with suppliers, category management, logistics and other internal stakeholders to maintain a competitive product offering.The position combines day-to-day operational responsibilities with opportunities to participate in broader commercial and category management activities.You will work closely with the local Head of Commercial Vehicles in Denmark and colleagues within the wider MEKO CV organization. Strategic category direction and additional support are provided by the responsible Group Category Manager.This is an individual contributor role without personnel responsibility.Din ProfilYour profileWe are primarily looking for someone who understands the technical and practical side of the heavy commercial vehicle industry.You might currently be working as a Spare Parts Specialist, Parts Manager, Technical Sales Representative, Product Specialist, Workshop Coordinator or Product Manager. Your current title is less important than your experience and knowledge.A background from truck and trailer workshops, spare parts distribution, fleet maintenance, agricultural machinery, construction equipment or other heavy-duty applications may be relevant.We believe you bring:•    Strong knowledge of commercial vehicles, components, spare parts and their applications.•    Relevant experience from heavy commercial vehicles (truck, trailer, bus) or comparable heavy-duty applications – e.g. from workshop, spare parts, technical sales or product work.•    Good computer skills and the ability to work in a structured way with product information.•    An interest in developing analytical, commercial and product management skills.•    Initiative, curiosity and the ability to work independently while collaborating with others.•    Good communication skills and fluency in English, both written and spoken.It is advantageous if you also have:•    Previous experience in product management, assortment development or technical purchasing.•    Experience with Excel, ERP or PIM systems.•    Experience analyzing product information, sales data or market developments.•    Danish language skills or knowledge of other Nordic languages.•    A post-secondary technical education.Your understanding of trucks, trailers and heavy-duty components, combined with your motivation and willingness to learn, will be central to your success.Om företagetAbout MEKOMEKO is Northern Europe's largest player in the automotive aftermarket, with approximately 600 stores, 20,000 workshop customers and 4,600 workshops across eight countries, operating through strong brands such as Mekonomen, MECA and FTZ.The Group drives development in digitalization, AI and logistics, offering smart and sustainable solutions for vehicle service and spare parts. MEKO's vision is to enable mobility – today, tomorrow and in the future.In Denmark, MEKO operates through FTZ, a well-established name in the Danish automotive aftermarket. The Commercial Vehicle Division is an expanding business area with a focus on trucks, trailers and other heavy-duty applications.As part of the team, you will work in a dynamic international environment with experienced technical and commercial colleagues, contributing to the development of a business with strong growth ambitions.Location: The preferred base is FTZ's headquarters in Rørup, Denmark. Candidates living in Southern Sweden are also welcome to apply. The role requires regular on-site presence in Rørup, especially during the initial onboarding period. The practical setup will be discussed with the selected candidate.KontaktuppgifterContactIn this recruitment, MEKO Danmark is partnering with Autorekrytering. If you have any questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, please feel free to contact Clemens Döring, Clemens.doring@autorekrytering.se.We look forward to your application!

title: Product Manager – Heavy Commercial Vehicles
description: ArbetsbeskrivningFTZ | Rørup, DenmarkJoin FTZ and help develop our growing Heavy Commercial Vehicles businessFTZ is looking for a Product Manager to strengthen our expanding Commercial Vehicle Division in Denmark. In this role, you will work with product groups within Heavy Commercial Vehicles, including trucks, trailers and buses, and contribute to developing an attractive and competitive product offering for the Danish aftermarket.We are looking for someone with a strong understanding of commercial vehicles and their components, combined with an interest in product management and commercial development. Whether your background is in product management, spare parts, technical sales or workshop operations, your industry knowledge and motivation could make you the right person for this opportunity.You will join a growing business area where you can make a real impact, working closely with experienced colleagues both locally and across the MEKO Group.Your responsibilitiesAs Product Manager at FTZ, you will work within MEKO's Commercial Vehicle Division, supporting the development and management of several product groups within Heavy Commercial Vehicles.Based on sales and profitability objectives, you will collaborate with colleagues to ensure that the right product range, competitive pricing and accurate product information are in place, while maintaining close dialogue with suppliers and internal stakeholders.Your responsibilities will include:•    Identifying, initiating and supporting projects for the launch of new products.•    Preparing request-for-quotation material and product specifications for sourcing, and evaluating products in cooperation with colleagues across MEKO countries.•    Managing product phase-in and phase-out activities.•    Maintaining and administering product information in catalogues and PIM systems.•    Monitoring competitors and supporting pricing activities.•    Following up on product assortments, price levels, product performance and relevant actions related to obsolescence, returns and assortment changes.•    Acting as a product expert within your areas and supporting the sales organization with technical knowledge.•    Contributing to the development of an attractive and competitive product offering for customers.This is a broad, hands-on role combining operational product management with opportunities to contribute to commercial development. You will have regular contact with suppliers, sales teams, product colleagues and logistics functions.You will work closely with the local Head of Commercial Vehicles and the Group Category Manager, who provides strategic category direction and support. The position does not include personnel management.Din ProfilYour profileYour understanding of Heavy Commercial Vehicles and their components is the most important qualification for this position.We are looking for someone with relevant experience from trucks, trailers, buses or a closely related heavy-duty industry. You may currently work in product management, spare parts, technical sales, workshop operations, parts distribution or a similar role. Experience from agricultural machinery, construction equipment or other heavy-duty applications may also be relevant.To succeed in the role, we believe you have:•    Solid practical knowledge of commercial vehicles, their components and applications.•    Relevant experience from heavy commercial vehicles (truck, trailer, bus) or comparable heavy-duty applications – e.g. from workshop, spare parts, technical sales or product work •    Good computer literacy and the willingness to work extensively with digital product information and systems.•    A structured, service-minded and proactive approach to your work.•    An interest in product development, assortment management and commercial opportunities.•    Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate across teams and countries.•    Fluency in English, both spoken and written.The following qualifications are considered advantages rather than requirements:•    Previous experience as a Product Manager, Product Specialist or Category Manager.•    Experience with Excel, ERP systems such as AX or Enterprise, or Product Information Management (PIM).•    Strong analytical skills and experience working with product or sales data.•    Danish or other Nordic language skills.•    Post-secondary technical education.What matters is your technical understanding, your motivation and your willingness to develop your product management capabilities.Om företagetAbout FTZFTZ is one of Denmark's leading automotive aftermarket distributors, supplying spare parts, tools and solutions to professional workshops and automotive businesses.As part of the MEKO Group, FTZ combines its strong position in Denmark with the expertise, purchasing capabilities and international network of one of Northern Europe's leading automotive aftermarket groups.The Commercial Vehicle Division is a growing business area focused on trucks, trailers and other heavy-duty applications. You will join an organization with strong technical and commercial competence, close cooperation across countries and opportunities to contribute to the continued expansion of the business.MEKO operates across eight European countries through established brands, including FTZ, Mekonomen and MECA. The Group drives development in digitalization, logistics and sustainable mobility solutions, with a vision to enable mobility today, tomorrow and in the future.Location: The preferred base is FTZ's headquarters in Rørup, Denmark. Candidates living in Southern Sweden are also welcome to apply. The role requires regular on-site presence in Rørup, especially during the initial onboarding period. The practical setup will be discussed with the selected candidate.KontaktuppgifterIn this recruitment, FTZ Denmark is partnering with Autorekrytering. If you have any questions regarding the position or the recruitment process, please feel free to contact Clemens Döring, Clemens.doring@autorekrytering.se.We look forward to your application!

title: Swedish Speaking Learning Assistant
description: Tanto International School is seeking highly motivated, compassionate, and adaptable educators to join our team starting January 2027.The hours are 50% (8:15-12:15 Mon - Fri).The role may suit someone who is studying in the afternoon or who already has some commitments after 13:00 on some / all days.We are looking for a professional individual with a positive attitude, energy, and a genuine passion for supporting young learners.Role Requirements & Qualifications:    Language: Fluent spoken Swedish, plus conversational English.    Experience: Proven experience working with children aged 6–10 in a school environment.    Vetting: Must provide a recent police background check and two professional references from former managers or line leaders.The role will include aiding the Swedish teachers- supporting groups and individuals who are new to Swedish or in the early stages of accessing the language.What We Look For:We expect our team members to uphold high professional standards, engage fully in school life, and create a warm, nurturing environment where students feel safe, safe, and excited to learn. We believe every activity and lesson plays a crucial role in a child's growth.About UsEstablished in 1983, Tanto International School serves students aged 6–16, alongside a nursery program for ages 1–6. We take pride in our small, welcoming community and family atmosphere. Everything we do is driven by "The Tanto 3 Cs" — Care, Collaboration, and Commitment — fostering a culture of respect for students, guardians, and staff alike.How to ApplyTo apply, please submit your CV and a Cover Letter. To help us get to know you, please structure your cover letter using these four headings:    Your Interests    Experience in other school settings    What Makes You Stand OutNote: Your application must include contact details for 2 professional references (managers or line leaders).For further information about our school, please visit www.tantoschool.se.

title: Digital Operations Analyst
description: Permanent position available with a considerable portfolio of works for the next 5+ years    To build your career by assisting in the delivery of ‘leading edge’ engineering projects.    To work with a vibrant, agile and multi-functional team in delivering projects on time, safely, to budget and to the required quality standards.    To benefit from Kirby’s Career Development Programmes that will enhance your leadership capability.    Excellent package on offer with room for negotiations  About Kirby Group EngineeringKirby Group Engineering is an international multi-disciplinary engineering services contractor and leading provider of high-value engineering services to a number of ‘blue chip’ companies. Operating across Ireland, the UK, Europe and South Africa, Kirby has become the engineering service provider of choice in growth segments such as pharmaceuticals, data centres and power transmission and distribution. Our culture is innovative, collaborative and performance focused. The successful candidate will have the opportunity to grow and develop in a company committed to developing talent and rewarding performance.Role Purpose: To support the improvement of business processes, reporting, and digital solutions across the Business Unit. Working closely with operational, project, and digital teams, the role helps drive efficiency through automation, data analysis, and process optimisation. The position develops actionable insights from data, supports digital tool adoption, and contributes to continuous improvement initiatives that enhance business performance.Key Responsibilities    Identify and implement opportunities to automate processes, improve workflows, and reduce manual administration.    Develop and maintain digital solutions, dashboards, and reports that support operational and project decision-making.    Collect, analyse, validate, and present data to ensure accurate reporting across key business metrics.    Support data management activities, including system integrations, data ingestion, and the maintenance of data quality and integrity.    Troubleshoot digital tools, reporting issues, and system challenges, working with stakeholders to develop effective solutions.    Collaborate with operational, project, and digital teams to drive process improvements and support business objectives.    Provide training and ongoing support to users to encourage effective adoption of digital tools and processes.    Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance reporting, digital capability, and operational efficiency.    Stay informed on emerging technologies and industry best practices to support innovation and business growth.    Undertake other duties and projects as reasonably required to support the Business Unit and Digital Operations function.For more information on this role, or other Construction / Engineering opportunities across Ireland, the UK, Europe, or South Africa please review our careers page (Vacancies – Kirby Group Careers) or contact the Talent Acquisition Team at Kirby Group in confidence on +353 (0)1 454 0411.Kirby Group Engineering is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates, regardless of race, gender, disability, religion, sexual orientation, or age.

title: Licensed Veterinarian to AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital
description: We are looking for a licensed veterinarian with a few years of professional experience who wants to become part of our team and work broadly within small animal practice. With us, you will have the opportunity to use and further develop your expertise across several areas, from outpatient care and inpatient wards to emergency medicine, surgery, and on-call work.About AniCura Kumla Animal HospitalAniCura Kumla Animal Hospital provides highly qualified medical, emergency, and surgical veterinary care in a dynamic emergency setting and a welcoming environment.AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital is part of Area North, which includes animal hospitals and clinics across fourteen locations. The hospital consists of the Emergency Department, Inpatient Care Ward, Surgery Department, Outpatient Clinic, Rehabilitation Department, as well as support functions including Telephone Services and Reception.My name is Jens Berisson, and I work as the Hospital Director here at AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital. We are now looking to strengthen our fantastic team and are seeking a licensed veterinarian who is passionate about animal healthcare and wants to continue developing the hospital together with us.About the RoleThis role is ideal for someone who appreciates that no two days are the same. Your primary focus will be tailored to your experience and interests, but we would like you to be comfortable working across different areas of the hospital.Examples of responsibilities include:    Outpatient consultations and medical workups.    Care of hospitalized patients in the inpatient ward.    Emergency patients and emergency medicine.    Surgery and perioperative care.    On-call and evening shifts.    More advanced cases based on your competence and experience.Who Are You?We believe you are a veterinarian who:    Is a licensed veterinarian with several years of clinical experience.    Is confident in your professional role and able to work independently.    Has experience from multiple areas of small animal practice, such as outpatient care, inpatient care, emergency medicine, and/or surgery.    Enjoys a varied caseload and is motivated to broaden your clinical expertise.    Is confident in making clinical decisions and prioritizing when required.    Has a genuine interest in high-quality patient care and professional communication with pet owners.    Is a team player who enjoys collaborating with skilled and dedicated colleagues.    Is curious and wants to continue developing professionally, whether by deepening expertise in a specific area or maintaining a broad clinical role.    Is fluent in English, both spoken and written.Experience in emergency medicine, surgery, or a specialist qualification in canine and feline medicine is considered an advantage.Why Choose AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital?At AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital, you will become part of a dedicated and highly competent team where collaboration, job satisfaction, and patient focus are at the heart of everything we do.We are a well-equipped animal hospital with extensive expertise in areas such as surgery, anaesthesia, emergency care, and advanced diagnostics. This provides excellent opportunities for both variety and continued professional development.What many of our employees appreciate most is the strong sense of community. Here, we support one another, share knowledge, and work together to provide the best possible care for our patients.About AniCura SwedenSince 2018, AniCura Sweden has been part of Mars Veterinary Health, a global network that offers outstanding opportunities for knowledge sharing, innovation, and professional development.With more than 450 clinics and animal hospitals across Europe, AniCura is one of the leading providers of advanced veterinary care. In Sweden, we are one of the largest veterinary care providers, with operations spanning the entire country and a strong local presence.Our dedicated teams work together every day to provide the highest standard of care for every patient. Through a culture characterized by collaboration, continuous learning, and medical excellence, you will have the opportunity to grow, make an impact, and truly make a difference.We are covered by collective bargaining agreements and offer secure employment conditions, including occupational pension schemes, insurance coverage, and wellness benefits, as well as excellent opportunities for continued professional development throughout your career.Would you like to bring your dog to work? No problem. We have spacious facilities specifically designated for employees' dogs.Would You Like to Join Our Team?If you are an experienced veterinarian who values variety, responsibility, and the opportunity to work across a broad range of disciplines, we would love to hear from you!If you have questions about the position or your development opportunities with us, please contact:Jens Berisson, Hospital Director jens.berisson@anicura.seEmma Idman, Talent Acquisition Partner emma.idman@anicura.seWelcome to AniCura Kumla Animal Hospital – where you can make full use of your veterinary expertise.

title: Sales Coordinator Nordic Region
description: We are looking for a proactive and highly organized Sales Coordinator to support our Nordic Sales team.
